Here in Arizona, we believe ONLY U.S. CITIZENS should vote in America... Now Biden is SUING us!
My name is Debbie Lesko -- I'm about to lose it, so let me be very blunt:
Here in my home state, we believe ONLY U.S. CITIZENS should vote in our elections... **But now Joe Biden is SUING Arizona because we require proof of citizenship to vote!**
I knew I had to do something right away. [**That 's why I'm launching a brand new, one-day-only survey for the American People.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60822920:JI-nDNVND:m:1:3299561967:8E3BAD163176A27A84ED3E8FDEF51B2F:r)
It's only a single question -- so please take a minute to add your response. _Your honest feedback is really important to me._
* * *
**Official Republican Poll:** Do you agree that ONLY U.S. CITIZENS should be allowed to vote in America?
**[YES](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60822920:JI-nDNVND:m:1:3299561967:8E3BAD163176A27A84ED3E8FDEF51B2F:r) **[NO](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60822920:JI-nDNVND:m:1:3299561967:8E3BAD163176A27A84ED3E8FDEF51B2F:r)****
_Important note: If you have strong feelings on this issue, please make sure to respond before closing out of this email. All responses after 11:59 PM (EST) tonight will NOT be counted._
* * *
I know this survey might be an obvious answer for folks who think election integrity is important. But Joe Biden does NOT fall into that category and, truthfully, the only opinion that really matters to me on this issue is the American People.
**Because _that's_ who should be choosing our elected leaders!**
[**Remember -- I 'm only conducting this survey through the end of the day. If you think ONLY U.S. citizens should be voting in our elections, please respond to my official poll right now.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60822920:JI-nDNVND:m:1:3299561967:8E3BAD163176A27A84ED3E8FDEF51B2F:r)
Blessings to you,
Debbie Lesko

| July 18, 2022
Good Morning Diehl-Allen volunteers! Please read the following for how you can get involved in this important election:
SIGNATURE COLLECTION FOR BALLOT REFERENDUM
If you assisted over the past week with collecting signatures for the ballot referendum on repealing the law giving illegal immigrants drivers' licenses, please do the following:

1. Turn in your sheets to our Plymouth HQ(6 Main Street Extension, Plymouth, MA)
2. or Mail them to Amanda Orlando, 1 Western Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930.
3. Email Annette Benenato and let her know how many signatures you collected over the past week.

We are looking for volunteers to collect signatures this week into the weekend as well. | | Housing is considered “affordable” if it consumes less than 30% of a household’s total income. Unfortunately, nearly half of renters are paying more, some spending over half of their income. **What are the effects?**
* It places greater stress on paying for other necessities — food, healthcare, and transportation.
* It limits the ability to change or find a better-paying job.

Affordable housing is vital to our communities and economic well-being. If our workforce cannot afford to live in the communities that employ them, there are worker shortages, fewer jobs, and fewer resources for a community to sustain itself. **Why has the housing gone?**
* Increased low income and decreased middle-income residents who can’t afford the current housing.
* Lack of supply. America has fallen short of 3.8 million houses by some estimates.
* Cost of building
* Attitudes — Not In My Backyard (NIMBYism) needs to be replaced with YIMBY (Yes In My Backyard)
* Land-use regulations / zoning
* Inadequate financial support; local, state, and federal tax credits to those in need
* Profit. Increasingly corporate involvement** __**
* And sometimes Greedflation

To tackle this issue and care for our neighbors, we need a representative willing to find solutions. My opponent has [**publicly stated**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47968096/356393553/-1840568091?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDMwZDFiMS04YTA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tTy-tqmQdXp2aZPy5EqbGLlBmATK_r08VnIl3MX16dU=&emci=51be244d-8806-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=0030d1b1-8a06-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) it is not a federal issue deserving his attention. If elected, I will work at a federal level with state, tribal, and local leaders to ensure all hard-working residents in my district can attain the basic human need of housing. This is who we are — caring, committed neighbors and friends, employers and workers, and community leaders. It will take a federal leader willing to bring all players to the table, but we can do this together. Together, we will address this issue. Together.

body:

Our "Introduction to Western Philosophy" course is now available
on DVD. And you can reserve your copy today.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os2wCyYhNR

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

Our "Introduction to Western Philosophy"
course is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy
today.

Aristotle wrote: "All men by nature desire to
know."

The pursuit of knowledge about the most
important things has been the central activity of Hillsdale
College for over 175 years.

In contrast, most American colleges and
universities have embraced the "postmodern" idea that knowledge,
like truth, is relative-that there are no real answers to
questions like "What is the best kind of life?" and "What is the
right way to act?"

In 1931, Winston Churchill wrote an essay
where he imagined a future where mankind had secured a life of
great pleasure, wealth, and convenience. But, Churchill wondered,
would that be sufficient for happiness?

What did they know more than we know about
the answers to the simple questions which man has asked since the
earliest dawn of reason-'Why are we here? What is the purpose of
life? Whither are we going?'

No material progress, even though it takes
shapes we cannot now conceive, or however it may expand the
faculties of man, can bring comfort to his soul.

Hillsdale's free online course, "Introduction
to Western Philosophy," examines just such questions as Churchill
poses.

This course pursues answers to these
questions by studying the arguments of great Western philosophers
such as Plato, Aristotle, Thomas Aquinas, Immanuel Kant, and C.S.
Lewis.

And this 14-lecture course is now available
in a special DVD box set perfect for viewing in your home or a
small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool
curriculum or personal study.

The "Introduction to Western Philosophy" DVD
box-set can be yours with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more
to Hillsdale College. Reserve your copy today using this secure
link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-introduction-to-western-philosophy-dvd

Hillsdale produces and promotes free online
courses, as we do all of our work while refusing to accept
government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or
state student grants or loans.

With your tax-deductible gift today, we can
enroll thousands of Americans in "Introduction to Western
Philosophy" and other online courses on topics such as the
Constitution and American history.

Please help promote Hillsdale's free online
courses such as "Introduction to Western Philosophy" and other
educational outreach efforts in this critical time for America
with a tax-deductible gift.

And remember, when you give a gift of $100 or
more today, we'll send you a special DVD box set of "Introduction
to Western Philosophy" as our thank-you. Quantities are limited,
though, and you won't find this DVD anywhere else but from
Hillsdale.

You can make your tax-deductible gift in
support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts and receive
your DVD box set using this secure link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-introduction-to-western-philosophy-dvd

Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in
its educational mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

Peter,

As a Hispanic female running for Congress in Texas, I have a message for First Lady Jill Biden: **We're more than just "breakfast tacos" as you described us today in a speech you gave in San Antonio. **

We're Americans, just like you. **We're not a one size fits all culture like you and your party like to believe**. Your snafu highlights the reason your husband and his Democrat allies in Congress are losing the support of Hispanics like me in droves. You guys in D.C. like to think that we're all alike. We're not.

[**THIS IS WHAT A REPUBLICAN LOOKS LIKE** ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60822108:6TegiNVNm:m:1:3317145305:C4B58A25D8EC770800DCE9F3EBCCC25C:r)
We're nothing like you think we are. **We believe in God. We believe in the right to bear arms. We believe in a strong familial unit. We believe in personal responsibility and accountability**. These are all things neither your husband nor his party believes in. And that's why this former Democrat left the party to join the Republicans. Your party no longer represents us.

**As a single mother from South Texas who owns her own business, I can attest that breakfast tacos are a delicious breakfast - particularly convenient for those of us who have no time to sit down and eat a full breakfast at the White House**.

To anyone reading this email right now: **[I'd like to send First Lady Jill Biden some of South Texas' best breakfast tacos and I'm asking for you to make a contribution to my congressional campaign today to help me do that](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60822108:6TegiNVNm:m:1:3317145305:C4B58A25D8EC770800DCE9F3EBCCC25C:r)**.

**I'm going to attach a note to the order of tacos letting her know that she's inspired me to work extra hard now to flip my South Texas congressional district red for the first time since 1903**.

[** CHIP IN $3
SEND A BREAKFAST TACO TO JILL BIDEN**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60822108:6TegiNVNm:m:1:3317145305:C4B58A25D8EC770800DCE9F3EBCCC25C:r)

**We're more than just breakfast tacos, and we vote**.

Thank you,
Monica De La Cruz
Republican for Congress - TX-15

body:
We cannot create change on the issues that matter if our voices are silenced at the ballot box. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47968549/356394991/823540626?refcode=ea.548b6b26-9106-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.548b6b26-9106-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NDhiNmIyNi05MTA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5ob185c3feS_GKA481gVbaQb1BzZA9DP2iGuaGLnCHI=&emci=1750ff01-7204-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=548b6b26-9106-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=1049176)
Peter, **It’s no exaggeration to say that securing voting rights is key to protecting every other right we hold dear.** Voting for candidates who share our values — that’s how we defend and restore reproductive rights, fight against climate change, expand health care access, and so much more. Unfortunately, partisan gerrymandering and voter suppression have made it _much_ more difficult for Democrats to succeed in our electoral system. We cannot create change on the issues that matter if our voices are silenced at the ballot box. **And now, the Supreme Court is set to hear a case that could upend our democracy as we know it.** _Moore v. name: Jim Harden
subject: Banning Us from Google
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60823579:6zZjJNVTN:m:1:3317145305:E72E3F9CD7B756AECBDD8662A3328274:r "Headline") Peter: I don't know what's worse. A pro-abortion extremist throwing a Molotov cocktail in our medical office, or a politician abusing the power of their office to shut us down. In the end, they both want the same result - that CompassCare stops providing compassionate care to women facing unplanned pregnancies. And right now, New York's Attorney General Leticia James is targeting us. She's [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60823579:6zZjJNVTN:m:1:3317145305:E72E3F9CD7B756AECBDD8662A3328274:r "Document")demanding that Google remove our three offices from their searches because we're not providing abortions and saying that pregnancy centers are "dangerous and misleading." In other words, she's mad that we're saving the lives of innocent children and wants Google to block our free speech rights so pregnant moms won't learn about our facilities. We're not going to take this lying down and are prepared to fight back. But this is going to be a costly legal fight and frankly, we don't have the funds needed to ensure victory against these bullies. **[That's why we're asking you to chip in $25, $50, or $100 today to help us ensure that women at risk for abortion will always have a safe place to receive life-saving care.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60823579:6zZjJNVTN:m:1:3317145305:E72E3F9CD7B756AECBDD8662A3328274:r "That’s why we’re asking you to chip in $25, $50, or $100 today to help us ensure that women at risk for abortion will always have a
safe place to receive life-saving care.")** In CompassCare's 42 years of offering compassionate care to women facing an unplanned pregnancy, we've never seen such a coordinated attack from the government to shut us down. **In addition to the Attorney General coming after us, the New York Legislature passed a law to investigate, not the pro-abortion extremist group[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60823579:6zZjJNVTN:m:1:3317145305:E72E3F9CD7B756AECBDD8662A3328274:r "Headline")"Jane's Revenge" who firebombed our medical office in Buffalo six days previous, but pro-life pregnancy centers.** You read that right. In response to coordinated violence against our employees and the women who visit our clinic, the government is launching an investigation into pro-life groups like us! **[Our backs are against the wall. If you believe in our ministry to save the lives of preborn boys and girls, then we desperately need your $50, $100, or $250 donation to ensure we can stay open despite the government's attempt to shut us down.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60823579:6zZjJNVTN:m:1:3317145305:E72E3F9CD7B756AECBDD8662A3328274:r "Our backs are against the wall. If you believe in our ministry
to save the lives of preborn boys and girls, then we desperately need your $50, $100, or $250 donation to ensure we can stay open despite the
government’s attempt to shut us down.")** Peter 4:12 encourages us not to be surprised by the fiery ordeal as though something strange were happening to us but to "keep on rejoicing." I can attest to the fiery ordeal CompassCare is going through. But I believe in a God who keeps his promises and rejoice in the Lord knowing we can overcome the attempts by the enemy to shut us down. **[That's why I'm asking you as a follower of Christ to help defend us from the attacks by the enemy with your $100, $500, or $1,000 tax-deductible donation today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60823579:6zZjJNVTN:m:1:3317145305:E72E3F9CD7B756AECBDD8662A3328274:r "That’s why I’m asking you as a follower of Christ to help defend us from the attacks by the enemy with your $100, $500, or $1,000
tax-deductible donation today.")** The victory against Roe has emboldened the enemy to double down on their efforts to shut us down. Help us fight back so we can continue the business of our life-saving ministry. **[Please donate today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60823579:6zZjJNVTN:m:1:3317145305:E72E3F9CD7B756AECBDD8662A3328274:r "Please donate today.")** For the preborn in Christ, [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60823579:6zZjJNVTN:m:1:3317145305:E72E3F9CD7B756AECBDD8662A3328274:r "Rev. James R. Harden") Rev. James R. Harden, M.Div
CompassCare CEO [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60823579:6zZjJNVTN:m:1:3317145305:E72E3F9CD7B756AECBDD8662A3328274:r "CompassCare")

name: Team Trone
subject: Got plans tomorrow?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by David Trone for Congress, Inc
body:
Peter,
Tomorrow is primary Election Day in Maryland! As you know, this election is incredibly important. We need to show a strong turnout so Republicans know we mean business come November. Do you have a plan to vote tomorrow?
If you already cast your vote by mail or during early voting last week, thank you for making your voice heard! If you didn’t, make a plan to do so tomorrow. Here’s what you need to know:
Polls are open from 7:00 am - 8:00 pm. If you are in line to vote before 8:00 pm, you are allowed to vote!
Your polling place may have changed. Your precinct and polling location may have moved because of redistricting. Confirm your polling place by clicking here. [https://elections.maryland.gov/voting/where.html]
You can still cast a mail ballot. If you have a mail ballot but haven’t sent it in, you still have time. Either mail it in, making sure it’s postmarked by Tuesday; or bring the completed mail ballot to a voting place. Click here [https://elections.maryland.gov/voting/documents/Primary_Ballot_Drop_Box_List.pdf] to find a dropbox near you.
Take time to research the candidates in advance. There are races on the ballot from Governor to the local Board of Education. Be sure to research who you’ll be voting for before you sit down in front of your ballot. The League of Women Voters’ tool, Vote 411, is a great resource for information about candidates. Click here to use it. [https://www.vote411.org/?gclid=CjwKCAjw5s6WBhA4EiwACGncZVhHUwVYfprc68p1BWgcUqNzqfo2n1znHhLiWz-vqthFFICOZQJw9RoCVCMQAvD_BwE]
ID is not required to vote. When you arrive at your polling place, election workers will confirm your name, date of birth, and address to ensure your registration is accurate.
Take a moment to thank an election worker. We face a shortage of election workers this year, despite them being critically important to our democracy! When you vote, make sure to tell the election workers that you appreciate all that they’re doing to help conduct a free and fair election.
If you have any questions, we’re here to help! Feel free to email us at info@davidtrone.com [info@davidtrone.com] or call us at 240-907-2392 and we’ll do our best to answer your questions. Thank you for participating in this election, and we hope that David can count on your vote!
Best,
Team Trone
Paid for by David Trone for Congress, Inc.
David Trone For Congress
P.O. Box 83998
Gaithersburg, MD 20883-3998
United States

| | Peter,

You may not know this, but today is a gigantic day. It very well may be the biggest day of our campaign. Why? Because our pre-primary fundraising report is due today. We need to raise an additional $20,000 before the day ends. [Can you help us with a contribution of $100, $200, or $300 (or more)](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=622381e805&e=33b11688c1) right now?

But if that’s true, why the hell are they pouring more than $80 million into trying to buy this open Senate seat? It’s because they know that Tim Ryan can win. That’s why they’re propping up their Silicon Valley puppet JD Vance with beaucoup bucks—because Tim Ryan would give working folks another voice in the Senate. = Mark my words—Ohio is THE battleground that will decide the Senate this year. So let’s get to it. # From the Desk of Dominic Rapini
|
---
**Dominic Rapini Calls Out SOTS for Amateurish Handling of Republican Primary Ballots**
[](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=b330d47eb6&e=8763c56857)
**BRANFORD, Conn—** Dominic Rapini – the Republican endorsed candidate for Secretary of the State – called out the Secretary of the State’s office on Monday for the amateur move in the handling of primary ballots in light of the withdrawal of fellow Republican Secretary of the State candidate, Brock Weber.“When a horse scratches at the track, they use a marker to remove his name from the sheet. But elections aren’t horse races—a sharpie is not the solution,” Dominic Rapini said.Last week, Weber, announced his withdrawal from the three-way Republican Secretary of the State race. Shortly after, the Secretary of the State’s office sent an email to registrars giving them three options on how they address removing Weber’s name from the already printed ballots: using a sharpie marker to blot out his name, using a sticker to remove his name and hand counting the ballots, or reprinting and reprograming the memory cards.“If I was Secretary of the State when this happened, I would have had a contingency plan in place to reprint the ballots when Weber initially withdrew last week," said Rapini. “The Secretary of the State’s office chooses instead a lack of uniformity amongst our towns and municipalities that will create mass confusion and further diminish the integrity of our election process.”“I don’t believe a ballot should be altered after being printed. I would also like to know where the other SOTS candidates stand on this and why they are being silent? Is it because they don’t have any solutions or is it because they are content with the status quo?”Rapini concluded, “Simply stated, this is yet another example of incompetence and failure from Hartford.”

Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. [**We’ve been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming — which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zbr4e6q3keruiur73ufce1akf6tcm2oct5q8cr38_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shim9p34cth2bs)

---
For years now, we’ve been building our support base in an effort to become “cancel-proof” — so that radical companies like Front can't pull the rug out from under us like this. We've come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still vulnerable. [**You can help with your subscription today**.](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zvasklq9957pp8o8k1hjk3eq29h4agoc3cdr9gu0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shim9p34cth2bs) And remember — you won’t just be standing with the Bee; you’ll be standing up for free speech of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always win out. If you're familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can’t take a joke. As a matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as our “Man of the Year.” But thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like you who see the value of investing in free speech and good satire, we're still pushing forward. [**But today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence, now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation. Please help us build resiliency today by becoming a subscriber.**](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zn282etqduq4fjt5c12gj4vjng3ul32tq9f4je48_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shim9p34cth2bs) Our goal is quite simple: to become the Obi Wan Kenobi of the digital world. To paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united behind us, the woke tech elites can’t win. They can try to strike us down, but we will become more powerful than they could possibly imagine. [**Join the rebellion today.**](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zu827mqkvi94ss6aqvns0mhhhm7dtbnra5n71ri8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shim9p34cth2bs)

Peter,

Sean Patrick Maloney

> PRESS RELEASE
Q2 Fundraising Recap: Vikram Mansharamani Leads the Pack

---
CONCORD, NH - July 18, 2022 - Entrepreneur and U.S. Senate candidate Vikram Mansharamani released the following after the second quarter FEC filing deadlines for the GOP U.S. Senate primary:
"Robust candidate fundraising is a critical component to defeating career politicians like Senator Maggie Hassan this year. I am humbled by the outpouring of support for our campaign to restore the American Dream for all Granite Staters and to resurrect a common sense, business approach to Washington. I am a businessman, not a politician, and in just two short months, it's clear my message is resonating with donors and voters alike. Our campaign was able to raise more this quarter from donors than ANY of our primary competition," Vikram said.
The graph below summarizes how Vikram's second quarter donor fundraising compares with his main competitors in the Republican primary. It's also important to note that Vikram's totals are for a little over 2 months versus 3 months for everyone else.
---
|
---
| "Now with the other candidates in this race reporting their numbers, it's abundantly clear that Vikram has catapulted to become a major contender to win the Republican nomination to defeat out-of-touch Maggie Hassan this November," said Vikram For New Hampshire General Consultant Michael Biundo. He continued: "It's also clear that some candidates are 'cooking the books' when it comes to declaring their fundraising numbers, trying to hide how poorly they did. This is the type of accounting game politicians play in D.C., inflating numbers and hiding budget shortfalls, and this is how we got into the mess that we are in. The last thing we need in the Senate is another career politician playing games with numbers."
Vikram and his rapidly-spreading campaign will use the donor support to spread his political outsider message to voters across New Hampshire. The Granite State has had enough of career politicians who forget what it means to represent the people. It's time to send a businessman to Washington.

My name is Tyler Leonard and I am from the Karrin Taylor Robson campaign. If either of these would be of interest to you, if you would not mind sending me your address, I can get one of our regional political directors out to your house to give you a yard sign or get you onboarded to volunteer.

Thank you again for your support and we would love you for to get more involved in the campaign!

Very Respectfully,

Tyler Leonard

subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1sv9mfpduscl6tbcqarltp84ejgih63pni26acg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqn4tljc9p34ppmelqe4oj0mgpr7cbk6sqjcpthmerb6d3i6eq7dcb4ckr3csbnmv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i61j71c5lm3jrep366hgb4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clge8or4c3gm0oh5u)
This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmgesp48ejlkn8uk3s1cakr6m2k4e7gg21t1vjr0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhm8o71c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmea64hbj8p0k8d7u6epa2tb1p59av8pb24m21oo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhm8o71c1h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zc0hs68kb6n5o6mk6uftoierki83377bi5lgd30g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhm8o71c1h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: An Important Message From Kelly Schulz, Reminding You To Vote On Tuesday, July 19th
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ff394db82f16/theyre-scared-11819011?e=64ac72257a)
---
| |
---
| | Since I’ve entered this race for governor over a year ago, I’ve traveled the state and had the opportunity to meet tens of thousands of Marylanders.

I have been inspired by countless stories which I’ve heard on the trail and the pride that every Marylander has in our beautiful state.

In my travels from Garrett County in Western Maryland to Worcester County on the Eastern Shore, and every place in between, it is clear to me, that overwhelmingly, Marylanders want to keep moving our state in the right direction.

I am the only candidate in this race that will do just that.

Our campaign is focused on delivering you solutions to address the most pressing issues facing our state: [making our streets safe](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=f89ff93f6d&e=64ac72257a), ensuring that your children receive a [world class education](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=16ff93dd60&e=64ac72257a), and making Maryland more [affordable](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=ea54ec2e00&e=64ac72257a).

I am the only candidate who is standing in the way of one-party rule in Annapolis, and a tidal wave of tax increases, less support for our law enforcement, and massive spending programs.

As your governor, I am going to fight each and every day to improve your livelihood and to make sure that you and your family can have every opportunity to succeed in Maryland.

Count on it.

**Polls are open on Tuesday, July 19 th from 7 AM until 8 PM and if you haven’t returned you mail-in ballot please have it postmarked by July 19th. **

This election is critical for Maryland’s future and every vote counts. I hope that I can count on your support and earn your vote.
---

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmhb4c8k7grmvnkv6fgq7o5l1fpafoao4cg0nvqg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbq7acpi6ph62s5mcoqe0tr2mgqnctbnckrm5d3lcti6ap366hh64sjlmiq75dj76v970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666rjac77m9qmcc3n6dg6fc5lclp238h1e8he4933clge8or5cpg60oh5u)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zs18v3q63s3okc03vp2ciogfhg9fbuqnnbsdqngo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhmapj0c1h2bs "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0ek3tp15md3ojril9u4c5279evrkvgunnso9m30_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhmapj0c1h2bs "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcltg2ac5fuokhrrlfja009omn9grscbpbesduog_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhmapj0c1h2bs "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z35o85oq5r2ht05etelfr2a3nh8h0dk496t26jo8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhmapj0c1h2bs "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zo0jleskdear30g1qujb5tso9eb10nhf1v1qp01o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhmapj0c1h2bs "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5b8tdi072cr5sstknba09lf5ia705ihrgmcggf0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhmapj0c1h2bs "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9fjue1d46v5ntcovl21sv83urif8ag17vv29pgg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhmapj0c1h2bs "I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zn45hhik09kqpo7c4v2sn2t3he27o68k1j0hobe8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhmapj0c1h2bs "Footer Graphic 1")
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmmcig7nok2q5ns2h99u8ehbdrp52iqca89r2vr8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shhmapj0c1h2bs "Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?")**

Peter,

I want to be vulnerable with you for a moment and share my personal painful story about my own coming out experience.

**In 1994, my Republican opponent outed me as gay with bigoted and homophobic ads to our district. I hadn’t even come out publicly yet!**

For members of the LGBTQ+ community, coming out is an extremely personal and sensitive moment. So, you can imagine my horror and heartbreak upon finding out I had been outed so publicly in such a hateful way. I was crushed.

**I ended up losing that extremely competitive race and it wasn’t until 18 years later that I finally won my race for Congress in 2012.**

Peter, I’m so glad that in the face of such discriminatory attacks, I didn’t give up.

Now, I can fight for LGBTQ+ equality and dignity in our nation’s capital and stand up for other marginalized Americans.

But sadly, since 2012, Republican bigotry and vitriol has not slowed down. name: Josh Harder
subject: a tough week
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Harder for Congress
body:
Peter,
Bad polls. Rating changes in the wrong direction. Experts predicting a "Red Wave" here in the Valley.
I promised to always be honest with you, so here it goes: it hasn't been a great week for our campaign.
When experts as smart as Nate Silver at FiveThirtyEight are saying we have a real chance of losing, and that the Central Valley could be the reason Democrats lose the House this November, it's a tough pill to swallow.
And it's a hard week because I know so much is riding on this campaign for the future of our country.
At a time when our rights and democracy are on the line, it's incredibly scary to think about what it would mean if my opponent Tom Patti wins and hands control over to MAGA Republicans like Kevin McCarthy and Marjorie Taylor Greene.
I know it's difficult to feel excited about these midterms, but we cannot get complacent. It is elections like these that have MASSIVE impacts on our kids' future. Trust me, Republicans are fired up in my district to take back control.
That's why I'm asking you to please chip in to support my campaign today so we can continue organizing this summer and reach more undecided voters.
Here is a link to donate: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-July2022-FR-July &refcode2=Peter**](https://act.myngp.com/el/2FWaNrsLTIoZdNkGCqGjhNO-acZQnguGWmdoqemqdrA=/JljxK8ljm8AgYQ_6lv9msU8ZaUW8nQFc0o7C0u3CeCs=?refcode=E17063-20220717-Personal-SL-CampaignNews-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25)

subject: What happens when you donate to Giffords PAC
disclaimer_text: paid for by donations made in response to emails like this one
body:
We send a number of fundraising emails, so we thought it important to take a step back to let you know what happens when you make a donation to Giffords PAC.
#

Friends -
We send a number of fundraising emails, so we thought it important to take a step back to let you know what happens when you make a donation to Giffords PAC.
We recently launched a $10 million investment to mobilize gun violence prevention voters and elect candidates with the courage to act.
That’s paid for by donations made in response to emails like this one.
We work hard in a number of states across the country to pass critical legislation that makes communities safer, and to stop the NRA from passing legislation that makes us less safe.
One example of that is a bill we defeated in Maryland that would allow anyone to legally go online and buy a do-it-yourself gun kit—no background check required.
We won that fight, and donations made in response to emails like this helped fund that work.
And, of course, the bipartisan gun safety legislation that President Biden just signed is another shining example of the work we’ve done together on this issue. That bill was the product of nearly a decade of hard work and slow, steady progress.
Donations in response to emails like this have fueled our critical work at Giffords through the years.
So that is why we ask.
From the first small-dollar donation we received on January 8, 2013 from a high school teacher in Ellicott City, Maryland to the ones we’re asking for today, every contribution counts.
It all adds up. It all makes a difference. It all goes toward saving lives. So please:
[**Can you please use this link to make a $3 contribution to Giffords PAC today? We’ll put it right to work funding our lifesaving programs in states across the country and federal races and legislation. Hello everyone,
My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades.
Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. I didn’t know married life to a naval officer would be so busy or so enriching when we married in 1989. (Yes, I would do it over again!)
As a family, we were better for it. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. Deployments were made more tolerable when email came along, but Michael’s absence was always felt around the dinner table, on holidays, and during family events.
**No challenge we faced these last three decades, though, compares to the demands of running for the U.S. Senate.** Yet this is exactly why my husband is undertaking this next level of service — because he has consistently made the impossible look doable and the difficult look commonplace. If anyone can beat Chuck Grassley, he can do it. My sense is that the nation needs people like him.
Admiral Michael Franken, my hubby, is the right person to be Iowa’s next Senator. I believe in him, and I know he will wow you, as well. His soul is Iowa’s. **But if Mike is going to win, turn Iowa blue, and fix the many challenges Iowa, its citizens, and this nation face, he needs your help today.**

# Volunteer Newsletter
---
---
Happy Monday Team Brandon! 36 Days till Primary Day! Many people have reached out to ask how they can help Brandon. Starting this Thursday, we will be hosting twice a week (Tuesdays and Thursdays) phone bank nights! So how can you get involved? 1: We need people who would be willing to host these phone banks! We would like to have at least one host for each county if not multiple! Would you be willing to host at least one night a week? Nothing will be required of the host besides opening up their home or business or church! We will handle everything else! 2: We also need folks who will be willing to make the calls as well! It's super easy and we can make it fun! Please consider helping Brandon shake up Washington and the political insiders! 3: We will be knocking on doors again this Saturday! We will be knocking in Onondaga and Oneida Counties! Groups knocking in each county! Please email Michael@brandonforCongressNY22.com to sign up to help! ALSO, there will be PRIZES for whoever has the highest voter contact!! LET'S VOTE BRANDON!
---

Peter, I’ve long believed that the foundation of a successful democracy is transparency. The people deserve to know what their leaders are doing with the power they are trusted with. **** Unfortunately, transparency has not been the status quo in our Congress. While millions of Americans were struggling with the financial ramifications of the pandemic, [members of Congress were getting richer](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/mRNLFKyANPYkYXuUTzk_S8dnu7zQexwzHV9zPwwj_iJFbCN04KarHEzeEfKHK1RAfxbIkqx8y6M8zExD0Oo3xPWSxbD2LvYLAZLh2TIP3S3e2-UZZrQ4bpGX_KMGhdfaBMNedwreghJ55-puB14sYKIUAHWeMfdvdoZ8M2L00rUNnu5upyqmzQr7CMQ0GqqGy0Ta_Quhn_xL6qvsupBlJx0J7EUnSvMcEJZLAV1PQYCsVYEyAwEJSI7pvz52dK1gPzse3isB4lFl3484SiSzNszITyZSvMyM15ZbLWX6VyE/3nu/2q9q2T9fT1m2CGtPJV-ySw/h0/eyJY1CrIGUQU50CdYIrW1L-QYpzHF-VnpvEK8ZVLqYk) by profiting off privileged information that they have access to. In Congress, legislators in both parties have used their positions to amass large scale personal wealth. They use their access to privileged information to buy and sell stocks ahead of the market. This abuse of power must end. **** Members of Congress simply should not be allowed to trade individual stocks. Trading on insider knowledge can also only lead to one thing: affecting policy for profit. clean_body: In Congress, legislators in both parties have used their positions to amass large scale personal wealth. They use their access to privileged information to buy and sell stocks ahead of the market. This abuse of power must end. | | Peter, I’ve long believed that the foundation of a successful democracy is transparency. The people deserve to know what their leaders are doing with the power they are trusted with. ** Unfortunately, transparency has not been the status quo in our Congress. While millions of Americans were struggling with the financial ramifications of the pandemic, by profiting off privileged information that they have access to. In Congress, legislators in both parties have used their positions to amass large scale personal wealth. They use their access to privileged information to buy and sell stocks ahead of the market. This abuse of power must end. Members of Congress simply should not be allowed to trade individual stocks. Trading on insider knowledge can also only lead to one thing: affecting policy for profit. In Congress I will prioritize passing legislation that bans our representatives from trading stocks. ** Transparency doesn’t just apply to other legislators. It applies to me too. If I want you to choose me to be your congressman, you deserve to know everything about me. Decide for yourself whether I’m fit to be your representative. I promise you that I’ll never be afraid of my constituents looking over my shoulder. I’ll take on corruption in Congress even if I lose friends in Washington. My campaign is funded entirely by the grassroots without ultra-wealthy donors or Super PACs. Max Miller doesn't play by the same rules, and he currently has a large fundraising advantage over us. Sincerely, Matthew Diemer Democratic Candidate for Congress OH-7 | Diemer for Congress P.O. Box 16753 Rocky River, Ohio 44116 | | | Sent via . body:
Did you see Peter’s email on Friday?

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=667%2E61531%2EezkiFM)
Hello,
Did you see Peter’s email on Friday?
The filibuster is single-handedly keeping Senate Democrats from using their hard-earned majority to pass the progressive legislation already passed by Peter and his colleagues in the U.S. House. The GOP has used this convenient loophole to deny civil rights to Americans for years, and it’s long overdue that we abolish it.
Peter’s committed to doing all he can to end it right away, but he needs our support on the way there. Please take a moment to read his note, and then [**add your name to our petition to end the filibuster once and for all.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-end-filibuster?source=em_20220718_p_t_filibusterkicker&t=3&akid=667%2E61531%2EezkiFM)
Thanks so much,
Team Welch
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Peter Welch <hello@e.welchforvermont.com>
Date: Fri, Jul 15, 2022 at 12:00 PM
Subject: No more filibuster
To: Friend <dpwillis67@gmail.com>
Hello,
Throughout my career in both Vermont and Washington, I’ve been recognized for my ability to work across the aisle with my Republican colleagues. For many years, I believed there wasn’t an issue we couldn’t iron out by listening to one another and coming together on a proper solution.
I’m writing to you today because that no longer seems to be the case. Many of the progressive ideas we’ve been able to pass in the House have gotten stalled in the Senate because of Mitch McConnell, the GOP, and an outdated, abused Senate rule. Because of the filibuster, the minority is allowed to continually block progress—even on the most pressing matters—hurting Vermonters and Americans nationwide.
Abortion rights, gun control, voting rights—these are urgent issues that demand our immediate attention, but Senate Republicans won’t even budge. **There is no greater threat to progressive change in America than the filibuster, and that’s why we must abolish it immediately.**
[**We can overcome our current gridlock by making one basic change to the Senate rules. Add your name to our petition if you agree we must end the filibuster.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-end-filibuster?source=em_20220718_p_t_filibusterkicker&t=4&akid=667%2E61531%2EezkiFM)
[SIGN MY NAME](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-end-filibuster?source=em_20220718_p_t_filibusterkicker&t=8&t=9&akid=667%2E61531%2EezkiFM)
---
The filibuster has no place in modern-day politics. It’s a relic of the Jim Crow era, infamously used by segregationists to block civil rights. It’s eerie, and frankly sad, to see Senate Republicans use the filibuster for similar purposes in 2022.
The filibuster holds us back from doing so much good for Americans. If you send me to the Senate, I will be one more vote to end the filibuster for good.
But this isn’t a fight I can win alone. Much of what we’re fighting for has broad support from folks across Vermont and the entire country, but we still fall short when it comes down to a Senate vote. Our democracy is at stake here, and we need everyone to make their voices heard on this one.
[**If we’re going to move forward on the issues that matter to the majority of Vermonters and Americans across the country, the Senate must eliminate the filibuster. Add your name if you agree.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-end-filibuster?source=em_20220718_p_t_filibusterkicker&t=5&akid=667%2E61531%2EezkiFM)
Thanks again for all you do,
Peter

disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
#

Alex Padilla is the son of immigrants from Mexico. He was born and raised in the proud working class community of Pacoima, California, in the San Fernando Valley.
[](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-july22.2BzSSa&refcode=em220718-1-subs&t=1&akid=893%2E159979%2EzkolTU)
He worked hard and dedicated himself to books and baseball, graduating from San Fernando High School before heading to MIT, where he earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering.
[](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-july22.2BzSSa&refcode=em220718-1-subs&t=2&akid=893%2E159979%2EzkolTU)
After graduating he moved back home and got to work, first as a member of the Los Angeles City Council, and then in the State Senate before being elected California’s Secretary of State.
[](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-july22.2BzSSa&refcode=em220718-1-subs&t=3&akid=893%2E159979%2EzkolTU)
As Secretary of State (and therefore California’s chief elections officer) Alex worked hard to make CA’s elections among the most accessible, inclusive, and secure in the country.
[](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-july22.2BzSSa&refcode=em220718-1-subs&t=4&akid=893%2E159979%2EzkolTU)
And when Kamala Harris became Vice President, Governor Newsom appointed Alex to take her seat — the first Latino to ever represent California in the U.S. Senate.
[](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-july22.2BzSSa&refcode=em220718-1-subs&t=5&akid=893%2E159979%2EzkolTU)
Now, Alex is running to finish the remainder of that term, _and_ for a full six-year term. **And we need to win BOTH in order to keep him in the Senate.**
[**So please, make a contribution to Alex’s campaign today. The Senate is a better place with Alex Padilla in office, but it’s up to us to make sure he gets the chance to serve a full term.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-july22.2BzSSa&refcode=em220718-1-subs&t=6&akid=893%2E159979%2EzkolTU)
**[DONATE](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-july22.2BzSSa&refcode=em220718-1-subs&t=7&akid=893%2E159979%2EzkolTU)**
Thank you!
Team Padilla

Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate

subject: Humbly asking you to read this

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9499%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=dC1nG7ELOmM%2fo9N1JSrLYg&sysid=1)
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38088%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dQwJBmU7drMslmsb%2fSvuQg&sysid=1)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38088%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dQwJBmU7drMslmsb%2fSvuQg&sysid=1)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38088%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dQwJBmU7drMslmsb%2fSvuQg&sysid=1)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38088%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dQwJBmU7drMslmsb%2fSvuQg&sysid=1)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn’t have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38088%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dQwJBmU7drMslmsb%2fSvuQg&sysid=1)
---

This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we’re outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38089%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KUb3E0DZ4ZajsJMuhj2K%2bg&sysid=1)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38080%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WwZSh8V5rlt9j3dmXJ3nDA&sysid=1)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---

* * *

I talk to folks every day who say they haven’t donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn’t close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we’re only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

body:
| | | Team, **Tomorrow is Election Day.** All of our door knocking, phone calling, and fundraising has led us to this moment. All of the thousands of volunteer hours devoted to building this movement; all the support that has poured in; all the hope that voters have put into our campaign. It all comes down to this. Turnout during early voting and by mail so far has been low, and that means **whoever wins the surge of voters tomorrow likely wins the Election.** We only have one day left to give it everything we’ve got. Tomorrow is Primary Election Day in Maryland and voters will choose the candidates that will run in November’s General Election. I urge everyone who hasn’t voted yet to do so — and I respectfully ask for your vote for re-election to represent you in the United States Senate.
Tomorrow’s primary is the important dress rehearsal for November 8th where recent national polling shows that Democrats have a small — one percent — advantage among voters questioned about which political party they would like to control Congress next year. The good news is that represents a bump up from several months ago. The bad news is it’s way too close to be statistically significant and past experience tells us that we need to be leading by more than one point to keep control of Congress.
The stakes are sky high — a return to a Republican-controlled House or Senate would be devastating for our democratic institutions, our rights and freedoms, and a long list of issues and decisions that are fundamental to the kind of country we want to be. We need a government that operates on the basis of facts, science and truth, works for ALL Americans (not just GOP super-donors and the mega-rich), and respects our laws and Constitution.
It’s going to take all of us working together to WIN — but we pulled it out in 2020 in the midst of the COVID pandemic and I know we can do it again!
[**The 2022 Midterm Election will be a nail-biter and we need to be ready. I am taking nothing for granted here in Maryland, and I'm also working to support Democratic candidates in key battles around the country. Chip in any amount you can today to help us win here in November and to prevent Rep. Kevin McCarthy and Senator Mitch McConnell from gaining control of the gavels next year.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47999897/356500945/1549897676?refcode=&refcode2=d61745b7-d006-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&contactdata=3k1UO6hWL9LiYUSWywCspQskm0UVVJeRWxDiROOEhFqpENlbLmzYaKxgBCLpGgnu&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjE3NDViNy1kMDA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WH8hPuHqDdSY7Hb5XVk-WA966mJp0KcVYZPWfN7JHxg=)
Thank you for staying engaged and standing up for what’s right.
All my best,
Chris

clean_body: = Tomorrow is Primary Election Day in Maryland and voters will choose the candidates that will run in November’s General Election. I urge everyone who hasn’t voted yet to do so — and I respectfully ask for your vote for re-election to represent you in the United States Senate. Tomorrow’s primary is the important dress rehearsal for November 8th where recent national polling shows that Democrats have a small — one percent — advantage among voters questioned about which political party they would like to control Congress next year. The good news is that represents a bump up from several months ago. The bad news is it’s way too close to be statistically significant and past experience tells us that we need to be leading by more than one point to keep control of Congress. The stakes are sky high — a return to a Republican-controlled House or Senate would be devastating for our democratic institutions, our rights and freedoms, and a long list of issues and decisions that are fundamental to the kind of country we want to be. We need a government that operates on the basis of facts, science and truth, works for ALL Americans (not just GOP super-donors and the mega-rich), and respects our laws and Constitution. It’s going to take all of us working together to WIN — but we pulled it out in 2020 in the midst of the COVID pandemic and I know we can do it again! = Thank you for staying engaged and standing up for what’s right. body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl5nmj9hlcjcpnuj8q1dgtoanbk98t12o7ihv33o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqb8sdj6mr7fdj7mdp7ccji69gnacdh6sp6as36m3h30sphclqm4t9lc4om1d5gsv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666rjac70e9p6cc9imdgmfc5lclp238h1e8he4933clge8pr2cdj64oh5u)
[](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zq0bm9u7v1l5dd141mdai2081tslcpj7ok9aaneo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm4or6c9h2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zodnvndjsebe9pb1uel0ui85qotapv688hp5h9to_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm4or6c9h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvatnhmr5fplcbl0ig8jbu8uuanpjmgrgvnuti8o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm4or6c9h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjf0su70ils0n1nuk9ts74gedbamqf47cik6l390_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm4or6c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zg3n5m7vcqbn8jmm6o3bt0u7h166lfr4p1pfrm2o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm4or6c9h2bs)

[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zoiamc6eib0dpkdein3d3jjmbl4lj3ege5bv7i3g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm4or6c9h2bs)

[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zf3gtbjfl8fu907c40f79d7q3lt48mu08tfo548g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm4or6c9h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfl88a7mars1ja60ucsagis5vb41vv3acr1o8dmo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm4or6c9h2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Typical insults
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsk7vwYhGN

These out-of-touch liberal elites are so threatened by rational
thought that they will call me radical for standing with everyday
people on the side o
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osk7vwYhGN

Friend,
if you turn on the news, there's a good chance you'll hear my
name.

Typically, it's alongside a dishonest legacy media headline
misrepresenting my agenda, insulting the people of Florida, or
implying FREEDOM is the latest and greatest threat to America.

It is an
insulting and absurd way to distort the truth and mislead you,
the American public.

Their
attempts at intimidation won't work on me though. I am not
backing down. Not even a little bit.

I welcome
the "insults" and the hard work to refute them because I know the
importance of strong leadership in a time like this. That is why
I'm running for re-election, and I hope you'll pledge your
support for my campaign.

If you're
still hesitant about getting involved, I'd like to remind you
what we're up against. It is evident how far to the left the
media has gone by looking at how they define "radical."

Allowing grown men and women to assess personal risk and decide
to wear a mask or not: RADICAL.

Allowing CHILDREN under 9 years old to make life-altering,
sometimes irreversible, decisions about their "gender identity":
JUST FINE!

Encouraging an educational environment focused on learning and
preparing students for the real world: RADICAL.

Encouraging students to hate themselves, their peers, and our
country: JUST FINE!

The
stakes could not be higher.

These
out-of-touch liberal elites are so threatened by rational thought
that they will call me radical for standing with everyday people
on the side of common sense and sanity. If that makes me a
radical, so be it.

I will
always defend our liberty, protect our children, and promote the
ideals of our Constitution which make our country the greatest on
earth. No amount of intimidation or petty name-calling is going
to change that.

>>
SUPPORT RON DESANTIS NOW >>

From my
time in the Navy to my time in Congress, I have always been
committed to preserving our freedom and building a better future
for our children.

I have
three children, and I worry every day about the consequences that
progressive policies could have on their lives.

We have
open borders inviting millions of illegal aliens, potential
criminals, and thousands of pounds of illegal drugs into our
country. At the same time, liberals try to defund our police
forces and appoint judges who are soft on crime.

We're
experiencing record-high inflation which threatens families with
higher costs at the pump and the grocery store, all while the
Biden administration spends your tax dollars into oblivion.

We have
kids - who are just trying to get an education - being injected
by the anti-American agenda of woke corporations, woke
politicians, and fraudulent media elites who have lost their grip
on reality.

I will
never let these out-of-touch fanatical liberals win. JOIN RON
DESANTIS NOW!

As a
federal prosecutor, I dedicated my time to convicting child
predators and removing dangerous criminals from our Florida
streets. I continued my mission in Congress by authoring bills
that ended the secret taxpayer-billed slush funds members of
Congress were using to pay off those who accused them of sexual
harassment.

Our law
enforcement, prosecutors, judges, and elected officials should
work to protect us - not to protect criminals. Now, as Governor,
I am standing by our law enforcement officers and holding the
Soros-funded, soft-on-crime prosecutors accountable to keep our
communities and our families safe.

I took
immediate action to end the COVID theater which crippled our
nation and focused on empowering small businesses with
common-sense tax policies which made it easy to hire American and
fuel our Florida economy. Florida is in a better place now than
it was before the pandemic - and that's not something liberal
governors can say today.

I'm also
leading the fight for parents and students against the poisonous,
WOKE elitists to ensure our education system is NOT an
indoctrination camp.

It's
simple: we're not going to tell kindergarteners they are racist
or they are oppressed. And we're not going to force-feed our
children progressive ideologies that are confusing and wildly
inappropriate for their age.

We will
prepare the next generation for greatness by teaching real
history instead of perverting our past to serve the ideological
goals of far-left activists who would like our children to hate
America and each other. Every student should feel empowered to
succeed - and together, we can make sure that they do.

If all
this is "RADICAL," then Friend, I think you and I have something
in common: we're both RADICAL. I could use your help continuing
what we started here in Florida. Will you chip in now to become
an official supporter of my campaign?

YES, I
WILL: $100
YES, I
WILL: $75
YES, I
WILL: $50
YES, I
WILL: $35

Make no
mistake: this race won't be easy.

We know
liberals will do anything to win when they're afraid of the
opposition. And they're VERY afraid of me.

They've
already proven they'll try anything to keep me out of the
Governor's mansion.

Since I
became Governor, we have made big moves to ensure Florida's
election laws are free and fair. We made it HARDER TO CHEAT by
banning ballot harvesting, strengthening voter ID, and
prohibiting "Zuckerbucks."

I have no
doubt they'll try harder to make sure we don't outsmart and
outfight them in 2022. That's why I need the support of patriots
like you, to make sure we're prepared to win whatever battles we
face next.

URGENT
DONATION: $35

Friend,
I've seen what we can accomplish in just a short period of time.
I've watched us win and lay the foundation for future successes.

But I
also know that this is just the beginning.

That's
why I am asking you for your help now. It's time for patriots
like you and me to come together and ensure this "radical"
freedom we're fighting for continues for another four years.

In an
election year like this one, we cannot afford to give one inch.
We cannot lose Florida to the woke progressives who would destroy
everything we've worked so hard for.

Are you
with me?

Please
donate to my campaign today using this secure link.

I
appreciate you reading my whole letter, Friend. Thank you for
your time.

Sincerely,

Ron
DeSantis

DONATE
NOW

Paid by Ron DeSantis, Republican, for Governor
