body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z06i03o2f9b92ekvj3man30tss4ksrhrkmljg64g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm2ob4clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbo7at9i6pjbctjjc6q3ddj0cpi60ptie9grcdr56djbbc5l69r6as5ieir70phn6v970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666rjac70e9q6cdb4mdi3fc5lclp2bs)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z4qertdmlkjd6ajnsrbjm2h673t1tlvbb34llnfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm2ob4clh2bs "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zsqdolci1n0vej238goknqh7ecj1i6c8qkhq2db8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm2ob4clh2bs "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zpcpr9ajnipvsj0jkt47ld4580d6638d5kfvev10_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm2ob4clh2bs "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zrjjuh77hcmc5l5nu3511gohcmcg3ogqmdhkcn6o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm2ob4clh2bs "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zc7m7c83vd0ph9a29hk5k1tdl5e1ecj37ae1dah0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm2ob4clh2bs "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. | | Friends,

**Instead of dividing the people of Connecticut, by race - we need to focus on building our community.**

Senator Chris Murphy is being ridiculous. Any and all violent shootings of innocent life in this country is a tragedy and we all know that. [So when Murphy tells people that "we value white life in this country more than black life," it's a blatant lie.](https://PeterLumaj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e4fb4f1b85edd41e1d869424a&id=84f424453c&e=ad1669c4a3) Worse than just being a lie, it is deliberately divisive, and seeks to drive Connecticut communities apart.

The only reason Murphy does this is because it's his only option to advance his agenda. He has been attacking our Second Amendment relentlessly for over a decade. And he knows his agenda is unpopular because we have an intrinsic right to defend ourselves and our families. So the only thing he can do it try to divide us.

We can't let that work. I am an unapologetically Pro-Second Amendment candidate for Senate. When CCDL's ratings came out they showed exactly that. But I'll need help working to protect your rights. Democrats from across the country are funding people like my opponent, Richard Blumenthal, to keep up the assault on our Constitutional Rights. body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6261%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=WW6QkCwpjVUWozdZiObwSg&sysid=1)
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64677%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wM9UuYm8bTO%2f2KbKRdSH1g&sysid=1)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64677%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wM9UuYm8bTO%2f2KbKRdSH1g&sysid=1)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64677%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wM9UuYm8bTO%2f2KbKRdSH1g&sysid=1)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64677%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wM9UuYm8bTO%2f2KbKRdSH1g&sysid=1)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn’t have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64677%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wM9UuYm8bTO%2f2KbKRdSH1g&sysid=1)
---

This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we’re outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64678%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=a4GUUmEeD3TRKBzABqX90w&sysid=1)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64679%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=H%2b3bBB%2f745RJ%2bur6G%2bKATg&sysid=1)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64670%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8VRCZg998gDwG9gFUg1Ycw&sysid=1)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven’t donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn’t close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we’re only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64671%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LB%2fa0cmQh%2fl3yNpYNmIIQw&sysid=1)**

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmuhbrim791447h8qr9j91kjgofsp17r0lq91fd8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm6oj2clh2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1rihbjpb9mcnjivaseusqluq938jfb72i3gnlf0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shjm6oj2clh2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe
VP, Development

clean_body: | | | | Cheney failed to vote on key issues, is no longer doing her job Rep. Liz Cheney, who consistently blames her Congressional schedule for her inability to visit Wyoming, was a no-show on "two key votes") in the House of Representatives last week. The House passed the “Women’s Health Protection Act” and the “Ensuring Access to Abortion Act” with mostly Democratic support. On each vote, Cheney was nowhere to be found and was recorded as “not voting” on final passage of "both") "bills"). Harriet Hageman, Republican candidate for the House, today issued the following statement: “Wyoming is very aware that we have no one in the House standing up for us, because Liz Cheney is consumed by her personal war with President Trump and is doing Nancy Pelosi’s dirty work on the January 6th Committee. But now she can’t even show up to do her job and vote on important issues, even though that’s why she says she can’t visit Wyoming. This is a perfect example of why we are fed up with Liz Cheney. We only have one House member in Wyoming, and we have to get it right. When I’m the next congresswoman from Wyoming, I will always stand up for our values and I will never forget who hired me for the job.” | | | | DONATE BY MAIL: Hageman for Wyoming P.O. name: Patrick Murphy
subject: Join us at the Vue Rooftop Bar
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Taking The Hill PAC |
body:
Dear Peter,

Just thought I'd let you know I'll be at the White House tomorrow July 19th for a Cyber Workforce and Education Summit. This conference of leaders from across government and industry is being led by the National Cyber Director to address the 700,000 cybersecurity job shortages across our Country and enhancing our National Security. As you may know, I have had the honor to serve on the Cyber Solarium Commission with leaders like Senator Angus King and Representative Michael Gallagher. The commission's work has yielded tremendous results, bringing cyber initiatives to the forefront of American Policy.

Following the event, I plan to have beverages with my Ankura colleagues at the Vue Rooftop Bar, Hotel Washington at 5:30 pm ET. This is a very informal get-together and no RSVP is required. Hope to see you if you're in town.

PS If you want to learn more about the work we have done supporting cybersecurity through the Cyber Solarium Commission, work at the United States Military Academy, or collaboration with municipalities in PA, please reach out to me or my colleague Neal Schubert at neal.schubert@ankura.com. Again, we hope you have time to stop by our informal gathering.

Hope to see you there!

Hon. Patrick J. Murphy
@PatrickMurphyPA

| | **MATT JACOBS AGAIN OUTRAISES BROWNLEY
** _Jacobs outraised Julia Brownley in Q2 and cycle-to-date
_ **Thousand Oaks, CA -** Matt Jacobs, former Federal Prosecutor and Republican nominee for U.S. Congress in California’s 26th District, raised nearly $500,000 in the second quarter of 2022 – over $135,000 more than incumbent Democrat Julia Brownley, according to recently released campaign finance reports. Jacobs has also outraised Brownley cycle to date, with over $1.66 million in receipts through June 30, 2022. In terms of individual contributions, Jacobs has raised nearly double Brownley. The second quarter reporting period of 2022 comprises two reporting periods: [April 1 to May 18’s](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=3a4206afb19a400f9d9311b695f6445d&_e=VNNJY0XoMEHBKCm6TVcAWHdEt-MTBiZuJYGGc6V0amPlgTRSdloLI6T2H6J0MsXQZxTV5CzpH1uEDNXWf2Ib3LVSYus0WXwAVAwN9TITCxKYngQlmncwxghnKIGvMsU-mrTEEOi_M2coY3BlWCl3D0iC-8O-XcdaNGBsgHHE_iASB3KiAD9UzhkK0sARjk3o5Ict4MVLw_XNPRapzDC9TS0mx_hPxKieQyhAHwIvUDnxN8jA_ZH__LeTEMQ7oSCrjvWYsrkMZBRaKH2r4J7IdzGBJv1S2PHScGsmoEsrUyLJhuz14R99qNbd9ZCr21gX) pre-primary report and the [May 19 - June 30 report](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=3a4206afb19a400f9d9311b695f6445d&_e=VNNJY0XoMEHBKCm6TVcAWHdEt-MTBiZuJYGGc6V0amPlgTRSdloLI6T2H6J0MsXQBCJN9zsSbgo0rJm1LBteRpHxN2cCLK1ze40-9oobxnK0x7Yp-NDNslhMoZoJ8_jS6tw4tRnQkooOWDljvCXwzgF9G44UD54sPH8vSqFZU7-QlVwKLqCrn68fzEFgrhTm0g0Zb_ZMUqQlZfXYZyd3TzVDIUKNtaW9Z7R9ibvS3zAD1A-pGQDEqkNPqbXFW7dIIF-tNJ7QrVdv1rzxMivpF4-ydqdocV8MMGM_WKbAmTftWktX9IJQzpIVrusfPKqG). _“People ask how a political outsider and first-time candidate like me has been able to outraise an entrenched 30-year career politician like Julia Brownley. The answer is simple: Julia Brownley has failed this community. People know it, and they’re excited to invest in change._ _ __“Brownley is a Far Left partisan whose votes have directly led to out-of-control gas prices, record-high inflation, the release of violent criminals, and dismal educational outcomes for so many of our kids. In short, she’s made life worse for people in our community.__ _ _“Voters in CA26 have had enough. They know we won’t get our country back on track if politicians like Brownley remain in power. They know it’s time to fire 30-year career politician Julia Brownley and send a proven fighter and true public servant to Congress,”_** _Jacobs said._** **###** **About Matt Jacobs -** Born and raised in Ventura County, Matt Jacobs devoted his career to serving our country and keeping our community safe. As a federal prosecutor, Matt took on our country’s worst enemies – terrorists, child sex traffickers, fentanyl dealers – and won. Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2a2b76e963584fc0a832125e3ab9ad6b&_e=uVu6YsvZlN2X7FvxUgmX95KXEmqPSasLkeBlx5ym3sqeCTbv_bVzY9_DZM53pb954v3Ymq7dpN8A9PO1R_hYH094pk-bYBhCzKOlsg_OrOXORiNb-YYwOiuTYlhAnZvwATXlJvHTzmH9Vl-i2NcLnB73sfaERT3IET2Cv-dixBM_fFlq_Qb2NbvLNc7z6zX541gYEBilGaS19_yPi5xjDGXvpYUvobtPLPjH9ElYWgcqRqOtODsjqrU2gBp7LrORCA7JQNigOrnNI7jQ0ehyqfr6XLAMx4G_cKn6c3XLEbBMYqCWFTPTlbx_UmoAxdE1qovTV-l7hyiMweiCwYDUg1-aCUx08ZbmsfvVrfovw3IX9zVu_J5fKrtIg2n30bFkyqETeGk4RD_09TyETP8KDyXezflDjAZu1wEzITddpwslAqApI4RbLC_vV8RwZoMc) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Progress is not guaranteed
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=kouG3l28y4Zc37ZAB9%2FKKtqJvInGyEN1&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
With Democrats in control of the White House and both chambers of Congress, we're closer than ever to making much-needed progress. But there is so much work to do on behalf of the American people, and progress is by no means guaranteed.
With a 50-50 split in the Senate we're teetering on a knife's edge - that's the fact of the matter. Moving our country forward is going to take leaders who are laser-focused on the most urgent issues of the day. Leaders who will fight for progress with a fierce determination. Leaders who rise above partisan squabbles - and prioritize our families and communities above politics.
**I strive to be such a leader in the Senate, and I'm eager to lead the charge forward on the issues that matter most to you in the Judiciary Committee; the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation; the Armed Services Committee; and the Committee on Veterans' Affairs. But to ensure I put your priorities at the forefront of my work, I need to hear from you directly:**
**[Will you take just a moment to let me know what issues and concerns are on your mind?](https://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-welcome-2021?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk981-su-nd)**
Here are just a few ways I've been fighting for the American people:
* Fighting for comprehensive relief for American families during the COVID-19 pandemic
* Calling for a 9/11 style commission to fully investigate the causes of the Jan. 6 insurrection - and secure accountability for those responsible
* Combating corporate greed - from the National Rifle Association and the gun lobby to Big Tobacco to Big Tech
* Protecting our children from the greed and negligence of the Trump administration
* Protecting the privacy of American consumers against the overreach of Big Tech companies and social media giants
* Suing President Trump to hold him accountable for his unconstitutional acceptance of payments from foreign governments
* Co-sponsoring the Green New Deal to combat the impacts of climate change and ensure that every family has access to clean air and clean water
* Protecting women's reproductive freedom by lead sponsoring the Women's Health Protection Act

These causes represent the values I've held since I began my career in public service - values I believe in profoundly and am dedicated tirelessly to uphold. It would mean so much to me to hear where you stand on the issues of the day: **[Please click here to answer a few questions about your priorities to make sure I'm fighting for the issues that matter most to you.](https://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-welcome-2021?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk981-su-nd)**
Thank you so much for letting me know what's on your mind,
Dick

We need a candidate who can take back the Office of Secretary of State from the Democrats. I am ready! | | | |

| Friends,

All hands on deck, the liberal ballot initiative deceptively titled, "Arizonans For Free and Fair Elections" has qualified for the November 2022 general election ballot. Do not be fooled by the name, this initiative has nothing to do with free and fair elections and everything to do with returning to an election system the democrats can manipulate since they cannot get the votes behind their candidates or their woke, build back broke, open border, closed economy and anti-parent policies.

I have been so successful at thwarting the democrats plans to cheat they have now resorted to circumventing the legislature and tricking the public into voting for their un-American initiative which guts our election system.

Many of the strong election integrity safeguards I have sponsored and successfully passed throughout the years will be repealed if this initiative passes. Not surprisingly, the democrats do not stop there -- also included in the initiative are a trove of new election changes, which read as the ultimate democratic wish list.
---
|
---
| | **Arizonans For Fair and Free Elections (aka H.R. 1 for Arizona)** **repeals four of my most significant election integrity reforms: **
* Repeals HB2023; Ballot Harvesting ban which was successfully upheld in the U.S. Supreme Court last summer.
* Repeals SB1003; prohibiting mail-in ballots with missing signatures from being tabulated if ballots arrive after the polls close at 7 PM on election day.
* Repeals SB1485, which stops mail-in ballots from being sent to voters who are no longer using Arizona's early mail-in voting system.
* Repeals SB1090, which prohibits county recorders from deciding where to locate emergency vote centers on their own. This bill was in response to then county recorder and my potential democratic opponent, Adrian Fontes, manipulating elections by putting emergency vote centers in predominantly democratic areas of Maricopa county.

**A small sampling of the 200+ damaging changes
included in H.R. 1 for Arizona:**
* Requires every eligible person applying or renewing their drivers license to be automatically registered to vote.
* Allows for same-day voter registration and voting.
* Adds public or private schools, college or universities or an employer to the list of acceptable photo ID's that can presented along with a non-photo ID bearing the electors address.
* Requires any voter registration application that is not accompanied by evidence of U.S. citizenship to be designated as federal-only. This means a voter who does _not_ show proof of citizenship can still vote, but only vote for federal offices like President and Congress.

clean_body: Join us tonight for a phone bank to get out the vote for Andy Levin and keep him in Congress. | | | Peter, The labor movement is making a comeback. Just this morning, staffers in eight House offices filed to form the first unions in Congress. And across the country at other major employers like Amazon, Starbucks, Apple, and Trader Joe’s, workers are winning some of the biggest victories for organized labor we’ve seen in a generation. As a former union organizer who spent decades in the labor movement at the forefront of legislative fights for workers’ rights, Congressman Andy Levin knows how important it is to keep the spotlight focused on the people who this moment is truly about: the workers. But right now, Andy’s taking on right-wing-funded super PACs who are doing everything they can to stop him from being re-elected and smash this resurgent wave of labor organizing. In Andy’s district, it’s working people vs. corporations — but we're going to out-organize the dark money forces swooping in to claim this seat, and win. **** As workers across the U.S. bear the full brunt of surging inflation and the rising costs of living amid overseas unrest and corporate price gouging — the surge in bottom-up, worker-driven organizing has been a silver lining. But Andy’s opponent, Haley Stevens, has a history of doing gig companies’ bidding and is part of the broader movement to stamp out workers' efforts to secure livable wages, safe working conditions, and reliable benefits. If she wins, the rights and protections of gig workers in Michigan could be at stake. Will you join us TODAY, July 18 at 6PM ET to phone bank for Andy? In solidarity, Working Families Party Thoughts? Peter, When I served as a fighter pilot in the U.S. Navy, I met the strongest people I know.

Naval officers are fighters like no other, and whenever I meet someone who served in the greatest fleet on Earth, I know I’m in good company.

**When I learned fellow Navy veteran Hung Cao was running for Congress, I was absolutely thrilled.**

Hung has the spirit that makes the Navy great. He served alongside special forces, dismantled dangerous bombs, and performed dangerous dives in some of the most difficult waters.

_With that kind of grit and perseverance, I know he’ll take that same strength to Congress._

Right now, we have a _record low_ number of veterans in Congress, Peter.

That means we need leaders like Hung more than ever, and I’m honored to support this fellow Naval veteran and true conservative.

clean_body: It's getting worse, Peter | | | Hi Peter – The GOP’s attacks on our rights are getting worse, if that's even possible. In the past few weeks, we've seen GOP candidates across the country promise to go even further on stripping reproductive healthcare, voting rates, education, and healthcare. If they win back the majority, which polling shows they're favored to do, we are in trouble. That's why we have to organize like hell to win small-town America. Republicans love stripping the rights of Americans, but notice they don't actually stand for any meaningful policy that improves the livelihoods of people in small-town communities. Democrats have consistently provided a stark contrast to the GOP's culture wars, fighting for clean jobs, infrastructure, gun safety, and inclusive healthcare. This is it, friend: **It’s hard to believe it’s finally here – but tomorrow is the Maryland primary election, which will determine whether or not our campaign for governor advances to the general election in November.** **[Can you pitch in one last grassroots donation to fuel us to the finish line?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47995870/356484411/-980145796?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220718tomorrow_wm_180da_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZmYxZjNhMC1jMTA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Un9pBTjvnUQbx8VSrtaQFXCk-2nfTXOJGpwXH0Rld7g=)** Over the past year, our people-powered movement has worked tirelessly to build a diverse coalition of support all across Maryland, and I could not be more impressed or honored. No one can match the Moore for Maryland team! Before Marylanders make their voices heard and cast their votes tomorrow, I want to remind you why I decided to run for governor in the first place. In spite of the struggles my family and I faced during my childhood — including losing my father at the age of 3, growing up in a single parent household, and starting to go down a troublesome path — I had people and a community who supported me and encouraged me to overcome the odds, and I went on to become a U.S. Army Captain, Rhodes Scholar, business owner, and executive at one of the nation’s largest poverty-fighting organizations. **I’m running for governor to make Maryland a state where we leave no one behind.** Because for a long time, that hasn’t happened here in Maryland. Too many Marylanders have struggled to put food on the table, pay their medical bills, give their kids a good education, and make sure they have a safe and healthy environment to raise their families. For the first time in eight years, we have the opportunity to flip this governor’s seat and usher in fresh, bold leadership that aims to lift every Marylander up and create generational change to address generational challenges. It’s difficult to listen to other candidates talk about fixing broken systems when their fingerprints are all over the systems that need fixing. **This is a moment for new leadership. It’s time to vote like our future depends on it.** **[I want to know if you’ll pitch in one last contribution to help our campaign pull out all the stops to reach every possible undecided voter before the polls close tomorrow night. name: Greg Casar
subject: Our plan for abortion access in Texas
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Greg Casar for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/greg-casar-for-congress?refcode=emailheader [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/greg-casar-for-congress?refcode=emailheader]
Hi Peter,
Over the weekend, our team led more than 50 Texas Democratic officials and abortion rights organizations in sending a letter to the Biden Administration, outlining five steps we can take now to get Texans abortion access in-state .
President Biden can provide a huge amount of support by making sure that Texans can see a health care provider, call them by phone or talk to them by telehealth, and then have medication abortion sent by mail into Texas from a state where abortion is currently not banned.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/94297/images/Texas%20Tribune%20Story%20-%20Biden%20Letter.png]
SHARE THIS STORY [https://www.texastribune.org/2022/07/16/texas-abortion-democrats-biden-emergency/]
We drafted this letter with the help of abortion providers, lawyers, advocates, and lawmakers, all committed to the fight here in Texas. Then, in less than 24-hours, we received an outpouring of support from our Democratic colleagues.
While some Texans can travel out of state, most working class Texans cannot simply take multiple days off of work and travel hundreds of miles for abortion care. We appreciate the steps the Biden Administration has taken already. In the letter, we’ve outlined five additional strategies that would help Texans get access to FDA-approved abortion medication inside state lines:
1. The Biden Administration can declare a public health emergency protecting private providers who dispense medication abortion via telehealth.
2. The Biden Administration can support mission-driven telehealth providers and abortion funds across America.
3. The Biden Administration can establish a Federal program for providers to dispense medication abortion and use federal immunity to prevent prosecutions.
4. The Biden Administration can invoke the Federal Government’s supremacy over state abortion laws that conflict with FDA-approved pharmaceutical regimens and regulations.
5. The Biden Administration can protect third parties within and outside the state of Texas from threat of civil and criminal actions where self-sourcing of abortion medications are used.
As an incoming Member of Congress, I’m committed to the important work of winning elections, building majorities, and passing legislation. But I’ve also learned how we must mobilize our community to take immediate action when an emergency strikes.
No strategy can substitute for Congressional action codifying abortion rights into federal law. But in these next few days and weeks, we must do everything we can to take care of our families who have lost freedom over their own health care decisions.
Please join me in sharing this story on social media [https://www.texastribune.org/2022/07/16/texas-abortion-democrats-biden-emergency/] and amplifying our efforts to help Texans get the abortion access they need.
In this fight,
- Greg
Greg Casar
Democratic Nominee
Texas Congressional District 35

So I wanted to take a minute to talk about what’s at stake in this race, because this election matters a whole lot. It matters whether or not we have enough votes in the House to fight climate change, defend voting rights, and codify the right to choose. It matters whether or not we help the regular families who are struggling amid rising costs — and take real action to make health care, housing, and child care more affordable. body:
| | | Peter, Because of the shocking Supreme Court decision reversing _Roe v. Wade_ last month, it is essential that every candidate running for office state his or her position on the subject of reproductive freedom and a woman’s right to choose. I believe that government has no business interfering with a woman’s health care choices, including any choice that she may make regarding abortion. **Therefore, I pledge to codify the protections of _Roe_ into federal law to provide again the protections and rights which the Supreme Court stripped away.** The Supreme Court had no business changing the law which was in place for over one-fifth of the life of our republic. On Fourth Amendment grounds and on Ninth Amendment grounds,**_Roe v. Wade_ was a decision that should have been affirmed.** I fully support and would have voted for the Women’s Health Protection Act of 2022 and the Ensuring Access to Abortion Act. Furthermore, if elected, I would support and vote for repealing the HYDE Amendment, which bars the use of federal funding to pay for abortions that are non-life threatening. The Supreme Court has given the green light to states that want to completely outlaw abortion, even in the case of incest and rape. In doing so, it itself has become radicalized and taken a position opposed by the vast majority of Americans. I intend to represent and serve the 10th District. In doing so, I promise to fight for and defend a woman’s right to choose and the privacy that all Americans are guaranteed under the Constitution. I hope that I can earn your vote for the August 2nd Primary and I look forward to working on behalf of this community that I’ve proudly served my entire life. Thank you, Carl [DONATE](http://links.marlinga4congress.com/u/click?_t=67a14e5cf5744cf5a340c02746c8071e&_m=39476b2c89114ffd9ef9e4ad9f78c1cf&_e=0NXQMSUuqROSyCqWOKxcfsY0E8OdhYaRPZx_Sj5evKFzRZ8ByC-ALApci-Xja5Pt-OPmzrTdafEKb2TFMOPALkxykREcJgA6dcjpCWkx0qX4SLeFywV0JpGMODF7IjI-K-LyPlC_3X3y3lFFwSSj38DLp1sPy5zm8B_-jYsME5eECYYc7hzpNmRbjJN3pSy5KPeKvt9_pmrXeBdLmnc7L20oCqJrYJINZSY1n7L5azCkXlBFD-jwx876C1WXRplFxCS7YvOjWe2pcexeOWFLzrsHNVhC8T8e1E3vmhWLj6SAWrXm4-JXrXVjpccsRWIB03lSkVODrr3K31jtIw6oh9uD1_EX9BpFxNbO3V5eYqw2UY1a3rrzM4_RinnUzk3yNaEa_8EvzDY2ZThNV6Dt4_Mbb4-43qKKX9CIb2JbF4NcIA54-YbZftw9LVzRnqrN_F23MU3Sv1Uz1uVTeeneYTtQdi-7kaO3fEarDaHRBKc%3D)

| | Peter,

**Radical left Democrats and establishment RINOs in Congress have enabled Biden to put America Last. Now our nation is facing a critical juncture due to Biden’s failed policies.**

After working in a variety of healthcare settings in my 20 years as a paramedic, my experience sets me apart as the most qualified candidate in the race for Tennessee’s 5th District.

As a parent of children who attended public schools in the area and having served as a PTO board member, I understand how essential it is to have a member of Congress who will serve families by putting children first when it comes to educational legislation.
---
| [ ](https://lee4congress.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=154a22b8198eb2b6409601e45&id=2c66c76929&e=0ee9ba69f7)
---
| _The days of Congress being comprised of incompetent politicians who failed to put Americans first are coming to a close_!

I just released my **America First** platform vision to address the urgent needs that we are facing across the nation. With my focus on six priority areas, we will get our nation back on track by bolstering our critical public service industries with the legislation, funding, and defense needed to reverse the devastation caused by Big Government.

As your next Congressman, I will be initiate my **America First Platform** , which includes the following six priorities:
1. **Mental Health** \- Introduce legislation similar to the 1980 Mental Health System Act to provide grants to states for community mental health services, similar to what President Kennedy first introduced.
2. **Border Security** \- Provide funding for additional law enforcement on the border, including technology, equipment, and resources to combat illegal drugs entering our country.
3. **Protecting our Protectors** \- Introduce Occupational Hate Crime legislation and making it a federal crime to target Law Enforcement Agents, First Responders, Doctors, Nurses, Teachers, etc.
4. **Health Care** \- Provide grants to communities for Community Paramedic Programs.
5. **Education** \- Eliminate funding for the Department of Education, and redirect those funds to local school districts to increase resources, retain teachers, and provide proper teacher salaries.
6. **Reduction in Foreign Aid** \- Immediately halt the trend of sending hundreds of billions of taxpayer dollars in foreign aid to other nations.

Additionally, I will also be taking a stand on the following:
1. **Will NOT Support** removing State rights on abortion issues or support any legislation that infringes on the State’s right to be Pro-Life or Pro-Choice. This issue should remain with voters for decision-making at the state level.
2. _**Will Support**_ legislation that provides the highest protection for Election Integrity.
3. **Will NOT Support** any legislation to promote Red Flag Laws. These laws place the burden on the citizen to prove innocence while interfering with their Constitutionally protected right to due process.

**As your next Congressman** , I will introduce legislation that holds anarchists accountable for targeting First Responders. Targeting an officer of the peace who is trying to ensure the safety of Americans should be categorized as a hate crime and be held accountable.

Help me in this fight for **Law and Order** and **First Responders** when you make a donation of any amount to my campaign today:

| |

| |

Dear Peter,

North Carolina is one of several states in the USA that requires a “certificate of need” (CON) before a physician group could build an outpatient procedure center?

Along with other states, like Massachusetts and Illinois, the rules of North Carolina require that a CON be obtained before a licensed surgeon or physician, or a medical practice group, can build and operate an outpatient surgery or procedure center. This would be done using the physician's own funds or personal loan, not taxpayers’ money. The process for obtaining this CON is onerous, involving much time and financial resources, and is almost never successful, as large hospitals or corporations which own hospitals block these applications.

When outpatient surgical centers are built and owned by physicians or physician groups, they can provide care, such as cataract surgery and even total hip and knee replacements, much more efficiently and at less expense to the patient (customer) than a large hospital! Any profit realized from this efficiency goes to the physicians, not to hospital or corporation bureaucrat coffers.

body:
Sarah Palin is running for Congress because she is sick and tired of what’s happening in D.C.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zb72chclrn2m8ritid9sjsplosnv1j6l145cg8kg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shge4pb2clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfac3imlp34tb0cqoncddmcepn9p5l6hrb7c5kmlo6aodkeji3cs5nc4q31p7561jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coored9gsurm4phhm2pm8dtgmlin49fg)

| | | Friend, it's Nikki Haley.

Sarah Palin is running for Congress because she is sick and tired of what's happening in D.C. She **won** her special election and now, she has to go head-to-head with three other candidates in one month.

That's why I'm reaching out to you right now. I need your help; I need your family's help; I need your neighbor's help. I've seen firsthand the power of grassroots support, and that's why I'm reaching out to you today. _**[Will you help me support Sarah Palin's victory?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrnpogg1h24pfdd6nun8vvr4jbf57l8p0u055up0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shge4pb2clh2bs "Will you help me support Sarah Palin’s victory?")**_

---
| | | [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsf2nsl6cj55jc5fddjkgkce98lrckbng2f5f8a8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shge4pb2clh2bs "DONATE NOW")
---

If Palin wins, she is ready to roll up her sleeves on day one and get to work slashing budgets, cutting taxes, standing up to liberal special interests, and standing up for the American people. However, she needs every single person reading this to step up and take action to make this possible.

We have just one month until Palin's election, which is why your immediate support is especially important. _**[I'm ready to fight for Palin and I need your help.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3bson6q7retl53dpio9r3eclcovhm93174kj5fg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shge4pb2clh2bs "I’m ready to fight for Palin and I need your help.")**_

---

Washington D.C. is full of out-of-touch politicians who want to tax and spend their way out of every problem.

With skyrocketing inflation, out-of-control spending, and crippling national debt, our country can't afford two more years of Democrats controlling DC.

That's why Palin is running for Congress. That's why I'm supporting her.

I'm ready to stand by Palin's side as she fights for America by slashing budgets, cutting taxes, and standing up for ALL people.

Washington will never change if we keep sending the same big-spending, status quo politicians to Congress. Palin is ready to bring commonsense policies and actions to Washington, but she can't do it without you.

_**[So I have just one question: Will you join me and support Palin too?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1ppo6mveeohl7mokop3mqqkfmf9altki4fkm1fo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0shge4pb2clh2bs "So I have just one question: Will you join me and support Palin too?")**_

Thank you for your support.

My very best,

Nikki R. Haley

Republicans love to say that they’re the party of “family values” — the party that looks out for parents and kids. Give me a break. I could go on, and on, and on, and on about how Republicans don’t do anything to actually support families. Democrats are the ones fighting for paid family leave; quality, affordable child care; strong public schools for every family; good-paying jobs that leave parents with time to see their kids; and a government that works for every family, not just the rich and powerful. But here’s what happens when Republican politicians win elections and get their way: More parents are forced to ration groceries and watch their children go hungry. More parents are forced to have hushed conversations at the kitchen table after they’ve put their kids to bed — conversations about how on earth they’re going to make rent, pay the mortgage, or cover medical bills. More parents — especially moms — are forced to give up their careers because child care costs more than their salary. More parents are forced to make impossible choices between going to work that day so they can buy groceries or staying home so they can take care of a sick child. More kids are forced to go to under-funded public schools, where some get cruelly punished for having little to no funds in their lunch accounts. More teachers are forced to deal with red tape that stops them from teaching honest lessons about Black history, or from trying to create safe, welcoming classroom environments for LGBTQ+ students. More working people and more retirees are forced to struggle to make ends meet and afford life-saving prescription drugs. All this, while actively forcing disproportionately low-income women and women of color to give birth — by shredding abortion rights and restricting access to contraceptive care. **I’m not willing to accept any of that. So I’m going to do everything I can to keep Republicans out of power in these midterm elections. name: John Legend
subject: Will you join me?
body:
Derek,
We’re at a turning point in our country. Even though Democrats have a thin majority, Republicans are using the filibuster to block important bills in the Senate.
50/50 is not enough. It’s clear we must expand the Democratic Senate majority to abolish the filibuster and make the real progress American people want. I believe Tim Ryan is our opportunity to do just that.
Will you join me in supporting his campaign? Please, split a donation of whatever you can afford between Tim Ryan and CommonGood to help us flip Ohio blue. Anything you give would mean a lot to me personally. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_tr?refcode=20220718_CGVA_Ryan]
I was born and raised in Springfield, Ohio . That’s actually how I got my start in music—performing in my church choir. I will always have a special place in my heart for the Buckeye State.
Ohio’s U.S. Senate race in November is one of the most important fights of our lifetime, which is why I couldn’t just sit on the sidelines. And you can’t either.
National Republicans and their billionaire backers are already spending upwards of $80 MILLION to keep Ohio red and ensure Mitch McConnell retakes total control of the Senate.
If that happens, voting rights, a higher minimum wage, affordable health care, high-quality education for all our kids, and more are in jeopardy. I don’t want to think about the damage that Republicans could do if they regain their grip on our government.
But the good news is if we win Ohio, Democrats can hold and expand our Senate majority. Even better news? Tim is neck-and-neck with JD Vance in the polls.
We CAN win, but only if you help Tim fight back against the attacks heading his way. Can I personally count on you to split a donation between Tim's campaign and CommonGood to help win this important race? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_tr?refcode=20220718_CGVA_Ryan]

Tim Ryan is the leader Ohio deserves. He will do whatever it takes to make sure working families get the support they need. That’s why we’re both counting on your help to win.
Thank you. I know how much this team means to Tim and it’s incredible to see so many supporters join this fight alongside us.
—John Legend

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Yes, people are really threatening to take away our right to travel between the states
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220718?refcode=lpfe220718_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220718?refcode=lpfe220718_m]
It is almost too hard to imagine, but it’s true.
Extreme lawmakers in Texas and elsewhere are threatening to take away our constitutional right to travel freely between the states, and threatening people and organizations that are helping women travel out of state for abotion care.
Over the last week, I have heard many people say it just can’t possibly be true as they try to visualize a world where you need a negative pregnancy test to board a plane or drive across the state line. But it is true. And it is not a secret.
Extreme Texas lawmakers are publicizing their threats to companies, claiming they are subject to felony criminal prosecution for HR policies that reimburse their employees for out-of-state travel for abortion care and have outlined legislation they intend to bring to criminalize.
I’m going to do everything I can to protect our reproductive freedom, including the freedom to travel for the care we need. And I am proud to tell you that the House of Representatives has already responded to this effort by passing my bill to protect the right to travel for abortion care last week.
https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/texas/article/House-passes-abortion-legislation-led-by-Houston-17307908.php [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/texas/article/House-passes-abortion-legislation-led-by-Houston-17307908.php]
https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/texas/article/House-passes-abortion-legislation-led-by-Houston-17307908.php [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/texas/article/House-passes-abortion-legislation-led-by-Houston-17307908.php]
The Orwellian future that lawmakers in Texas and elsewhere are proposing is fundamentally contrary to our values as Texans and Americans. But we have a lot of work to do to ensure their vision does not become our future. There is no simple, quick solution. In a state where the legislative districts are gerrymandered, and where statewide elected officials are working every day to make this vision a reality, we need a sustained, systemic, strategic effort to take back our state from extremists who don’t represent the majority of Texans, and don’t care what they think.
That’s why we must continue our work, on this campaign and campaigns across the state. We are working now on plans to turn out the vote in TX-07, and to elect the leaders our community and our country deserve. I’m so grateful to know I can count on you to do this with us.
Together, we can do anything,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]
P.S. As always, I need your help to keep up the fight. A contribution to the campaign so that we can mobilize Texas voters will make a difference today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220718?refcode=lpfe220718_m]

It’s clear the old Democratic playbook isn’t working.

We need new, bold ideas and fresh faces to excite voters and inspire the massive turnout we will need to win in November.

[Trust me, I know what it takes to win tough races.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48008127/356533382/1031471839?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220718_FR_TOUGHRACES_A0_na_U1_X1_M2&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYjU4YmI1OC1lZDA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0ADb_2aMbTcWWrycqPNcfg-Zsb37t1xxIHqx1DMGABM=) Before I decided to run for office, I was the Director of Video at Priorities USA, which helped Democrats take back the US House in 2018.

[That’s why I’m asking for your support.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48008132/356533384/1031471839?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220718_FR_TOUGHRACES_A0_na_U1_X1_M2&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYjU4YmI1OC1lZDA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0ADb_2aMbTcWWrycqPNcfg-Zsb37t1xxIHqx1DMGABM=) I know we’re the team that can cross the finish line in November and be your voice in D.C, but only if we have the resources to run a robust campaign.

| | Folks, ever wonder why such a wide diversity of voters are given just two political parties to pick from? In the [_**latest episode of Civics for the Culture**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48008435/356534368/-320950719?refcode=em_20220718_f_f_cftc_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNmM2ZjUwYS1lZTA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=crHitpfSjBF9lE83msKOFt5Pr-IDk_XzjdHTuqpkB3Q=), our host Chelsey Hall is breaking down the two-party system. Chelsey not only outlines the history and structure of the two-party system, she also clears up a common misconception: We actually have more than two parties — think the Green Party or the Libertarian Party — but the winner-takes-all structure of our elections concentrates power between the Democratic and Republican parties. The truth is, no voter is going to see their beliefs perfectly reflected in one of just two parties. We’re all too unique for that. But we can look at how our values fit within each party’s policies around taxes, immigration, healthcare, reproductive justice, environmental regulations, and more. [_**This**_ _** is all covered in episode seven of Civics for the Culture. Watch the latest episode here, and if you're able, please chip in $20 or anything you can to fund our voter education programs like this one.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48008437/356534370/-320950719?refcode=em_20220718_f_f_cftc_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNmM2ZjUwYS1lZTA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=crHitpfSjBF9lE83msKOFt5Pr-IDk_XzjdHTuqpkB3Q=) We’re not trying to tell people which party to vote for or convince them that this two-party system is perfect. But each vote has power and by understanding our political system, people can match their values and vote their interests. This November is a chance for every voter to make their beliefs heard and cast a ballot for the policies that can make a positive impact on their lives. That’s why we need voter registration and education programs that give that power to as many people as possible. By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Codifying Roe can’t wait
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
| With the upcoming Senate recess in August, if we don’t codify Roe now, we’ll be leaving millions of women in the dark for months until the next legislative session begins.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=514%2E5257348%2EMyrgvY)
Derek, we have the power to do something about the GOP attack on our rights. And we need to use it.
If you are indignant about the reactionary agenda of the Supreme Court, I am too. Because I know that Congress has the power to codify _Roe_ and reinstate the reproductive rights of millions of women, but hasn’t done so yet. And I’m horrified to see stories coming out about how, in post-_Roe_ America, women **_and children_** are being put into dangerous and awful situations just to receive basic healthcare.
If it were up to me, I would have passed legislation **immediately** to codify abortion access into federal law. In fact, I voted to codify _Roe_ last week. Again.
But right now, a handful of Senators are using the arcane filibuster to frustrate progress and stop pro-choice Senators from passing life-saving legislation for the people.
**And with the upcoming Senate recess in August, I know that if we don’t codify _Roe_ now, we could be leaving millions of women at risk for months until the next legislative session begins.**
This is a life-or-death situation, Derek, and I can’t sit back and let the Senate fail to do what the overwhelming majority of Americans want just because of the filibuster, a procedural anachronism that doesn’t even appear in the Constitution.
[**That’s why I’m speaking up now and asking for you to join me: Sign on today to demand the Senate change the filibuster rules and use our Democratic majority to pass legislation that guarantees a woman’s right to choose.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20220718-roe-filibuster.pdBUPG&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220718_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=514%2E5257348%2EMyrgvY)

Derek, we have the power to do something about the GOP attack on our rights. And we need to use it. If you are indignant about the reactionary agenda of the Supreme Court, I am too. Because I know that Congress has the power to codify Roe and reinstate the reproductive rights of millions of women, but hasn’t done so yet. And I’m horrified to see stories coming out about how, in post-Roe America, women and children are being put into dangerous and awful situations just to receive basic healthcare. If it were up to me, I would have passed legislation immediately to codify abortion access into federal law. In fact, I voted to codify Roe last week. Again. But right now, a handful of Senators are using the arcane filibuster to frustrate progress and stop pro-choice Senators from passing life-saving legislation for the people. And with the upcoming Senate recess in August, I know that if we don’t codify Roe now, we could be leaving millions of women at risk for months until the next legislative session begins. This is a life-or-death situation, Derek, and I can’t sit back and let the Senate fail to do what the overwhelming majority of Americans want just because of the filibuster, a procedural anachronism that doesn’t even appear in the Constitution. I am the third in a line of four women named Margaret. My grandmother, Margaret Cooke Byers, was born in 1897 and turned 22 on the day that Congress passed the 19th Amendment, which allowed women to vote. My mother, Peggy Byers Wood, saw women achieve the right to control their own bodies, finances, and futures with the Roe decision. I am the third Margaret, becoming the second woman in the history of America to be elected both Governor and Senator.

Over the course of my grandmother's, my mother's, and my lifetime, women have made tremendous progress towards achieving their rights as full and equal citizens in our democracy.

But now, for the first time in our country's history, a generation of American women have fewer rights than their mothers did.

**My daughter, the fourth Margaret in my family, is now less free than I was at her age.**

This is a grave moment for American women and for our democracy. The Supreme Court has taken away the freedom of half the population, freedom that most American women have known for their entire lives.

It seems daunting to contemplate where we go from here. But we have been in similar fights before. We have to keep fighting. We have to organize, mobilize, vote, and do everything in our power to protect our Senate majority – because if Mitch McConnell becomes the Majority Leader, he will ban abortion nationwide.

We owe it to ourselves and the next generation — to women like my daughter, Margaret number four — to keep fighting.

[**_So please, join me in this fight by splitting a donation of $25 or any amount you can between my campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia to protect our Senate majority and to continue the progress we've been working on for hundreds of years._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48008794/356535678/846586152?refcode=20220718.3_SenMH_7CF_C&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzUwYzZkNy1mMDA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a7lIKbQH1YJ1fcA-_s4vQqklcDJi5e-kHcGs4hRagOU=)

clean_body: | | | | = I am the third in a line of four women named Margaret. My grandmother, Margaret Cooke Byers, was born in 1897 and turned 22 on the day that Congress passed the 19th Amendment, which allowed women to vote. My mother, Peggy Byers Wood, saw women achieve the right to control their own bodies, finances, and futures with the Roe decision. I am the third Margaret, becoming the second woman in the history of America to be elected both Governor and Senator. Over the course of my grandmother's, my mother's, and my lifetime, women have made tremendous progress towards achieving their rights as full and equal citizens in our democracy. But now, for the first time in our country's history, a generation of American women have fewer rights than their mothers did. My daughter, the fourth Margaret in my family, is now less free than I was at her age. This is a grave moment for American women and for our democracy. The Supreme Court has taken away the freedom of half the population, freedom that most American women have known for their entire lives. It seems daunting to contemplate where we go from here. But we have been in similar fights before. We have to keep fighting. We have to organize, mobilize, vote, and do everything in our power to protect our Senate majority – because if Mitch McConnell becomes the Majority Leader, he will ban abortion nationwide. We owe it to ourselves and the next generation — to women like my daughter, Margaret number four — to keep fighting. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = = = = = = Thank you. With every good wish, Maggie Hassan | | Paid for by the Democratic Party of Georgia. My team and I are trying to reach every conservative in every corner of our district, but with skyrocketing gas prices, Biden has made this a very expensive endeavor. by the way, didn't even support Governor Ron DeSantis We drive thousands of miles a month on the campaign trail. I'm afraid that we're not going to be able to keep up the travel for much longer with rising gas prices. Our conservative House Majority is on the line in this race. But we're getting killed at the pump. I need your support to fill up the tank. Amanda Makki Conservative Republican for FL-13 P.S. Our get out the vote effort is going strong- but we could use your financial support to keep it going. Can you contribute to our Get Out The Vote fund? Here is a link to donate: | | Amanda Makki is an America First candidate for Congress in Florida's 13th District. A legal immigrant, attorney, and conservative national commentator, Amanda is a strong conservative with a proven record of fighting for the values and principles that made America the greatest country in the world! ---|--- | Paid for by Amanda Makki For Congress Don't want to receive any more of our emails? Last month, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, and we're already seeing the devastating impact of this decision.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48009320/356539134/-1862136002?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzU2OGFiYy1mNTA2LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xUuZpqIxxbz0na6CjeF2u956fr-th-heupH69NuOoNk=&emci=6234fffc-d806-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=dc568abc-f506-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=15384964)
Peter,

Last month, the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , and we're already seeing the devastating impact of this decision.

A ten-year-old girl in Ohio was forced to cross state lines to terminate a pregnancy after being raped because Ohio has banned abortion. Following this tragic event, Republican politicians announced their intention to prosecute the doctor who performed the procedure.

This is the world that women and girls face all across our country now that _Roe_ has been overturned.

Women should be free to make their own health care decisions without interference from extremist politicians. That's why in Congress, I will fight to codify the protections of _Roe v. Wade_ into federal law.

With Roe overturned and tragedies like the one out of Ohio becoming more and more common, it's never been more important we stand together and work to ensure we protect reproductive health care rights for everyone. Women and girls across the country are counting on us.

Seth

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: What I’ve been up to
disclaimer_text:

body:
Hey friend,

I’m reaching out to update you on the work I’ve been doing recently. As you know, over the past three and a half years we’ve made great strides on several fronts, including service improvements in our branch offices and overseeing the safest, most secure elections in Michigan history. With that said, this is a busy and exciting time in Michigan and I want you to know what I’m doing to serve our state and earn re-election in November.
Here’s some exciting news to start off: We are less than a month away from our first statewide election since 2020, and already over one million Michigan registered voters have requested their absentee ballot! That is roughly double the number who had requested absentee ballots at this point in the 2018 campaign year. It’s clear to me that Michigan’s constitutional right to vote by absentee ballot - which was approved by voters in 2018 - continued to be a big boost for voter turnout and our democracy.

Local clerks are busy processing this historic increase in ballot requests, and I’m working hard to ensure that on Primary Day - August 2nd - we will continue our tradition of safe, secure, and transparent elections in Michigan. We did it before, friend, and this year we’re going to do it again.

Will you pitch in to support my re-election campaign today to help ensure that I can continue protecting our elections and our democracy for years to come? secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=071822

The primary is almost upon us, which means Election Day is just around the corner! I’ve been spending time traveling across Michigan and meeting voters of all ages who are ready to defend our democracy in November. Some of the best democracy defenders are the ones I met at the Traverse City Cherry Festival who are still years away from being able to exercise their right to vote.

Meeting Michiganders from all walks of life is one of my favorite aspects of campaigning. And as always, the conversations I have invigorate me with a deep sense of optimism for the future of our democracy and our country.

These conversations are also important to reinforce the truth about the integrity of our election process and to fight back against the coordinated effort to undermine our democracy. Friend, will you make a contribution to my campaign today to help ensure that I can continue talking to voters and spreading our message across the state?

Donate>> secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=071822

Thank you for reading, and I hope to see you out on the campaign trail soon!

-Jocelyn

## Today's Top Stories
| | | | [](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59413&L=27674&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbmloLWZiaS1pbnF1aXJ5LW9mLXd1aGFuLWdyYW50Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXRpcHNoZWV0JnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=) | **[Judicial Watch: NIH Records Reveal FBI Inquiry of Wuhan Grant](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59413&L=27674&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbmloLWZiaS1pbnF1aXJ5LW9mLXd1aGFuLWdyYW50Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXRpcHNoZWV0JnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=)** Judicial Watch announced recently that it received 1651 pages of records from the National Institutes of Health (NIH) revealing an FBI “inquiry” into the NIH’s controversial bat coronavirus grant tied to the Wuhan Institute of Virology. The records also show National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) officials were concerned about “gain-of-function” research in China’s Wuhan Institute of Virology in 2016. The Fauci agency was also concerned about EcoHealth Alliance’s lack of compliance with reporting rules and use of gain-of-function research in the NIH-funded research involving bat coronaviruses in Wuhan, China. Grady is the spouse of Dr. Anthony Fauci, director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases. | | | | [](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59413&L=27651&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbmV3LWRvbC1wb2xpY3kvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249dGlwc2hlZXQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==) | **[New DOL Policy Shields “Vulnerable Workers who Lack Work Authorization” from Deportation](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59413&L=27651&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbmV3LWRvbC1wb2xpY3kvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249dGlwc2hlZXQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==)** Days after an influential open borders group ordered the government to “promptly develop and implement” a policy to protect illegal immigrants involved in labor disputes from deportation, the Biden administration has obliged. This month the Department of Labor (DOL) issued a new measure, drafted in English and Spanish, offering immigration related prosecutorial discretion for undocumented workers involved in labor disputes with their U.S. employers. Created at the request of the Los Angeles-based Center for Human Rights and Constitutional Law, the policy directs illegal alien workers to contact the agency if they fear supervisors will try to get authorities to deport them for reporting workplace abuse. subject: I promise you: This will make an impact

body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=WHH0TMUdBYy%2BG7%2F3CQJpAq7t2LR9bzhc&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
Here's the truth: If you make a donation of $5 today - before midnight - it will have a tremendous impact.
I understand one donation may not sound like a lot in the context of a crucial race for the U.S. Senate, but please know this: When people like you step up by the thousands and chip into our campaign, it means we have the resources to fend off relentless GOP attacks and run an aggressive, successful campaign - the sort of campaign it takes to keep a must-win seat blue and protect Democratic control of the Senate.
But you rightfully may be asking: _Why now? Why today?_
Because, Friend, as we speak, Mitch McConnell and the National Republican Senatorial Committee are actively plotting how they can flip just a single Democratic seat to take control of the Senate. GOP leaders are actively plotting what they would do with resurgent Republican control - including passing a federal abortion ban, stripping voting rights nationally, and preventing any more evidence of Donald Trump's wrongdoings from being made public.
As critically important as these dangers are for the survival of our democracy, there are also other issues at stake. Like the survival of our planet. Despite every effort to persuade and negotiate that has been made over the 18 months of this administration, it now cannot be denied that having a split Senate has blocked meaningful progress on climate change and sustainability. So we need not only to stop McConnell and the GOP from subverting our nation's freedoms, we also need to elect even more senators who will join me in fighting climate change and protect a future where those freedoms will be exercised.
As I have time and again, I will go toe to toe with Trump, McConnell, and their right-wing backers. I will do whatever it takes to keep their extremist, out-of-touch GOP agenda from being forced on the American people. And I will continue to fight with my willing colleagues to make meaningful progress to save our planet. **But I can only win and keep fighting when grassroots supporters like you chip in $5 to help me succeed.**
**[So please, before my mid-month fundraising deadline (I'm still $3,415 short), will you please make a contribution of $5 or more now to protect this seat and ensure Democrats keep control of the Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1216-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you,
Dick

Fellow American - they are coming after me again.

A Chuck Schumer-backed Super PAC, with the misleading name "VoteVets," released ANOTHER false attack ad going after me.

_**How low will they go before Election Day?**_

Fellow American, I want you to hear directly from me about these FALSE and misleading attacks:

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00cb861366db4cc3982d84284b9e042a&_e=9VzC9mLHvBm4fLFuPNphlTPrbF9f_yzF0TgPc_EFuNbnGrvoq_1bDIUJnG0BB0O2rtRQFIkje_FlQeGvIReWINX9-QSG7Xnw9w_bPjJoDa_40e3M6I2-HaovUucONsXz7sN04ZAGKAZdPQS0N8LrHA7Ich9rCsbcvrrUaCYs4OZvWlB3TJVdUQtQFwMbDPPzT1HrONe4mFq4XZwlUzVWRvexjaGhCBtEpiIjXVfue0Lk6VVWBbC_wksE8TQtSVH8ZyUBZKRwK9RhxpJEauvMNym3FqcSvI2Kci8ER_J6FOtyl_Y_xkPt5AYYTI4YKlA0TCoZzP-LAsZuc0WLs8pt7ZL9gMXIV0OPRAI5TziplDTRkd_nKN5VtdzZFYBcuDnHqDM5zjL1P_rLekvy5dnCoPf3c_F9XMNjYewWBk3SiBDfE5CbH6WuVMp-Q9-M9-5WrOXM6Ef0BxgKEJROejHmXzPdIfiW_JQ-wfeo4OMY9BI%3D)
"VoteVets" has a long track record of releasing blatantly false ads against Republican candidates.

Now they're trying to tear down the important work I've done to help our troops. **You see, this attack is PERSONAL because I don't just TALK about supporting our men and women in uniform.**

I have dedicated over a decade of my life to traveling the country meeting with members of our military to share my mental health journey, inspire hope for people who are struggling, and remove stigmas around seeking treatment.

This new attack ad suggests I've done something wrong, but it's a lie. The same article they clipped in the attack ad new clearly states, **"there's no indication [Herschel Walker] was directly involved in any wrongdoing."**

But since that line disproves their lie, "VoteVets" left it out of their ad! This is gutter politics at its worst, and it is why so many people are fed up with the swamp in Washington.

We MUST fight back and fully fund our ads so that voters in Georgia hear the TRUTH.

subject: Pelosi Stock Scandal Puts Spotlight on Double-Standard
body:
Folks have a hard time understanding how it is okay for the well-connected to play by one set of rules, while the rest of us are held to another. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/thelanderforcongress/pelosi-stock-scandal?e=f8a0a76a2b)
---
[](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=e35a232599&e=f8a0a76a2b)
# Pelosi Stock Scandal Puts Spotlight on Double-Standard
Ed Thelander today expressed amazement at how little Congressional leadership understands or cares for the tough times ordinary Americans are facing following news reports that Paul Pelosi, the husband of House Speaker Nancy Pelosi, allegedly took a $5 million stake in computer chip stocks just before a bill opening the federal spigot to spend on those very same chips came up for a vote. “This development, if true,” Thelander said, “only strengthens the case for barring members of Congress and their spouses from trading on stocks while in office.”

“Regular folks have a hard time understanding how it is okay for the well-connected to play by one set of rules, while the rest of us are held to another. Then they tell us how grateful we should be for the small-dollar stimulus hand-outs while Congress has lavished trillions on pet projects over the last two and a half years,” Thelander said.

Previous instances of wealthy figures in Congress making questionable stock trades when they held privileged information about upcoming policy changes have already fueled calls for new rules. California Senator Dianne Feinstein’s last husband Richard Blum made tens of millions of dollars in China-related deals after his wife changed her vote on Most Favored Nation Status for the communist country in the 1990s. Former Senate Intelligence Committee Chairman Richard Burr stepped down while his multi-million dollar sell-off of hospitality stocks was probed because it coincided with a Top Secret briefing he’d received that day about the economic impact of COVID-19 globally and in the U.S.

“Introduction of the “Trust in Congress Act” (H.R. 336) back in January is nothing but an election-year fig leaf. This has been going on for a long time. How else do you explain how so many members of Congress become millionaires on a salary of $174,000? Congressional leaders don’t seem to care what we think just months away from a potentially historic mid-term election,” Thelander added. “Earlier this summer we were treated to photos of the Pelosis enjoying themselves at a posh Italian beach resort owned by an opera star. Why couldn’t they have come to Maine and spent some of their money here? The very rich, who also happen to be the very powerful, just don’t get it.” _Ed Thelander is the Republican candidate for Maine’s 1st Congressional District and resides in Bristol._ For more information: (207) 449-5636 or info@thelanderforcongress.com
