# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220718-3228-header&t=1&akid=3228%2E2526796%2EenJu0g)
“Money talks.”
It’s an old adage that unfortunately rings very true in the world of politics.
Pundits look at fundraising numbers like sports stats as an indication of how popular a candidate or campaign is – and how much support there is for their ideas. **Right now, among the entire House of Representatives (Democrats and Republicans), AOC is in 11th place.** 1
While most of the campaigns ahead of us accept corporate money, Alexandria refuses to take special interest money and relies exclusively on grassroots donations. We're still the #1 small-dollar funded campaign is a testament to our movement’s strength and it’s truly only possible thanks to all of you.
We’re asking for your help to keep Alexandria as a top fundraiser so that we not only have the resources to carry out our plans, but also to help our priorities and policies get the legitimacy they deserve.
[So what do you say? Can you pitch in – $5, $15, $50 – whatever you can to help us start off this fundraising quarter strong?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220718.v9RicH&refcode=em20220718-3228-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3228%2E2526796%2EenJu0g)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220718.v9RicH&refcode=em20220718-3228-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3228%2E2526796%2EenJu0g)**
If we had our way, we’d have public financing of campaigns and not have to raise millions of dollars to defend against dark money attacks.
If money talks, then we want our money to come from bartenders and teachers and nurses, not corporate CEOs. And we want to raise as much as we can to show our strength and have the resources to build our movement as big as possible.
Thank you for reading and for all of your support. We’re very grateful.
Team AOC

Jayapal said: “They want us to get discouraged - we don’t let that happen.” Become an active member with Our Revolution to keep growing progressive dominance in Congress. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ZUCKERMAN ENDORSED BY BERNIE — AND US! Our Revolution joins Bernie in our strong endorsement of David Zuckerman to return to the post of Lt. Governor of Vermont! David is an organic regenerative farmer and longtime progressive independent voice in the VT House and Senate, where he’s led on: economic justice, marriage equality, cannabis reform, renewable energy, water quality, universal healthcare, and more. David said they’ve built a coalition of folks challenging incrementalist Dems in Vermont to meet the urgency of our times, while also reaching working-class folks of all stripes. [ ][IMG] “Bernie inspired me when I was a student in ‘92 — he said exactly what he believed and didn’t put his finger to the wind,” David said. “Some folks on the other side actually agree with us, they’re just sick of mealy-mouthed politicians.” He said our progressive policy message resonates with folks who feel left behind. “You used to come out of high school and be able to get a manufacturing job — that’s all gone.” “Reaganomics, ‘trickle-down,’ international exploitation of low-wage work overseas – all made it so decent people can’t put food on the table or a roof over their head,” David said. “We’re on the ground with folks seeing their issues and working to solve them.” [ ]Join David and Our Revolution in the fight for economic, racial, social, and environmental justice! Sign up to make calls with our 2022 Phonebank Force to get our progressive message out to the whole country. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution is proud to back Marc Elrich - one of our most effective progressive allies - as he fends off a challenge from a healthcare CEO for re-election as Montgomery County Executive in Maryland. “I like doing the work. The most important thing someone can do with their lives is to be purposeful and make a difference.” Marc told us on our [ ]National Organizing Call Monday night. [ ][IMG] In his next term, Marc told us his “goal is to accelerate our climate plan and push for rent stabilization” — earning him the ire of wealthy developers seeking taxpayer giveaways. Marc was a beloved 5th-grade teacher at Rolling Terrace Elementary, then a City Council and County Council member. He got his start in the movement by listening to MLK Jr. speak at the March on Washington and later was arrested at an anti-apartheid protest. [ ][IMG] In 2018 - by just 77 votes! - Marc beat out former Healthcare CEO David Blair, who’s running again on massive ad spends — which we are countering via direct voter outreach. Recent polls show Marc with the lead and he has an excellent shot to win this primary, but we’re mobilizing to power him over the finish line on Tuesday! [ ]SIGN-UP HERE to call voters for Marc and other great progressive candidates ready to partner with our movement for positive change. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] VOTE TUESDAY FOR SHEILA RUTH Tuesday is also Election Day for progressive Del. subject: My story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party of Wisconsin
body:
Fellow Patriot -- My name is Derrick Van Orden. You’ve probably never heard of me, but I wanted to tell you my story. I didn’t have much growing up, but my mom taught us to work hard, speak plainly, and _never back down from a fight._ So, I joined the Navy when I was 18, **and went on to become a Navy SEAL Senior Chief and defended our amazing nation in Europe, Afghanistan, and Iraq.** Serving America was the honor of my lifetime -- and it’s what led me to recognize that poor leadership in Washington can have devastating consequences. So, after I returned home to Wisconsin and saw the American Dream be eroded by the disgraceful career politicians in DC, I decided to step up and run for Congress as a conservative Republican in the nation’s most hotly contested election in Wisconsin’s Third District. You may wonder why I’m running...well, it’s simple: What we’re seeing in Washington right now is crazy. And I learned as a SEAL... **you can’t fix crazy, you can only stop it.** Look, I’m not a career politician or some elite bigwig... I’m a veteran and just a regular guy who is **sick and tired of know-nothing politicians and the fat-cat special interests running our country into the ground.** And unlike all the spineless politicians, I’m also not afraid to say that I am:
* **TRUMP endorsed and 100% MAGA**
* **Proud Christian husband, father, and grandfather**
* **Veteran and businessman**
* **Pro Capitalism, Pro Border Security, Pro Law Enforcement**
* **And most of all: PROUD AMERICAN**

We both know that’s not what the media and radical left want to hear, and the Democrats will do everything they can to shut me up. [**And that’s why I’m personally asking you to chip in just a few bucks to help fuel our grassroots campaign and help me restore some common sense to Washington.**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVhHU-RLyMJ8toduCUai2sULjJNWiii2tmYm7BfV82plU&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dvo_letter_v1&n=1) This race in Wisconsin is **THE battleground election that will decide who controls the House Majority.** Whoever wins this race will control Congress. It’s that simple. In only one year of full Democrat control, we’ve seen America be crushed: staggering inflation, empty store shelves, gas prices you need to take out a mortgage for. **We are better than this.** [**So, I’m hoping you will join me by supporting our conservative campaign by chipping in just a few bucks right now.**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVhHU-RLyMJ8toduCUai2sULjJNWiii2tmYm7BfV82plU&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dvo_letter_v1&n=2) | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVhHU-RLyMJ8toduCUai2sUKGCcC3gEn1v9VWxcHV4A1szY97t_xkZuLxfEyS8CuuY&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dvo_letter_v1&n=3 "CHIP IN $10 NOW") [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVhHU-RLyMJ8toduCUai2sUKGCcC3gEn1v9VWxcHV4A1szY97t_xkZuLxfEyS8CuuY&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dvo_letter_v1&n=3)

So, after I returned home to Wisconsin and saw the American Dream be eroded by the disgraceful career politicians in DC, I decided to step up and run for Congress as a conservative Republican in the nation’s most hotly contested election in Wisconsin’s Third District. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
This isn’t *just* about cheesesteaks.
#
How do I know my Republican opponent, Dr. Oz, is NOT ACTUALLY FROM PENNSYLVANIA??? 🤔🤔
It would have to be the fact that he recently stopped by Geno’s, aka one of South Philly’s most famous + touristy cheesesteak joints, for a bizarre cheesesteak photoshoot.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220718-2?refcode=em20220718-6565&refcode2=6565_434096_C9Cx_p&akid=6565%2E434096%2EC9Cx_p)
**Ah yes, the trip to Geno's — a rite of passage for every tourist.** 😂
Even Geno’s rival cheesesteak establishment, Pat’s King of Steaks, joined in on the trolling on Twitter. 👇
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220718-2?refcode=em20220718-6565&refcode2=6565_434096_C9Cx_p&akid=6565%2E434096%2EC9Cx_p)
**Because nothing says “I’m not from here” than choosing a cheesesteak joint that serves more tourists than actual Pennsylvanians.**
And look, I mean no disrespect to Geno’s, which I’m sure serves up a delicious cheesesteak.
But REAL Pennsylvanians know you’re probably better off going to Dalessandro’s or John’s Roast Pork to get your fix.
Now, I know what you may be thinking now. “John, come on, it’s just a cheesesteak.” **🙄**
Sadly, this isn’t *just* about cheesesteaks.
This is about choosing a Senator who understands + will fight for real Pennsylvanians, instead of a celebrity doctor making a mere pit stop at a tourist trap like Geno’s.
I have lived in + fought for Pennsylvania my whole life. And now I’m running for U.S. Senate to fight as hard for PA families as I fight for my own.
[**_Will you please make a donation of $13 (the price of a Geno’s cheesesteak) right now to help fund my campaign to defeat Dr. Oz? Send me to Washington, and I will fight like hell for working people + never embarrass you by doing a campaign photo shoot at Geno’s._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220718-2?refcode=em20220718-6565&refcode2=6565_434096_C9Cx_p&akid=6565%2E434096%2EC9Cx_p)

Thank you,
John

Lieutenant Governor of PA

| | Hello Peter, I want to take the time to introduce you to my friend Harry Montoya, candidate for New Mexico State Treasurer. Harry is a man of integrity who cares deeply for our state. As State Treasurer, I know he’ll bring accountability, transparency and the highest ethical standards to the office and I look forward to serving with him when we win in November.

Please take the time to visit Harry’s website at [https://www.harryfornewmexico.com/](http://links.markronchetti.com/u/click?_t=b07bd752cdb64edc94e23391776d0f53&_m=f5895e8ce1184156bbcf5efd79d508e1&_e=8_CXjbpQT5j_W_UtqFN4e2GKaN4oqnU1lMBpn5zr9V2iQndAXGzt9vWNRarxfrh3KjHrsFUME09HJTQwfrUAJmNeBojkspjeGYySOavXOTpOD-A8Pm-ZkqSPiTvdXjfAzgO_0TQ4UJTgZArru3spnbF-UDzXb_WLtTnUTQo4myWPLLnM8CxY4IPk8XAjVA66TtPpqSntrBWizEtPSDgniw5TLhP5GeS01y7Nl8iJXamnRU1Ac5TUChi6EZhlZOWdmHvseqe5GHmKuvLxyZ2VOw%3D%3D), add your name to his list and follow his campaign!

Onward to Victory in November!

Mark

**From:** Harry Montoya <[harrymontoya@harryfornewmexico.com](mailto:harrymontoya@harryfornewmexico.com)>**Date:** Monday, July 18, 2022 at 9:30 AM**To:** Mark Ronchetti <[info@markronchetti.com](mailto:info@markronchetti.com)> **Subject:** Have you heard?

| | Fellow New Mexicans, I am Harry Montoya, and I am running for New Mexico State Treasurer. **With your investment . . .****We can make New Mexico Proud Again!!

****I’m a Pro-Life... Pro-Second Amendment... Pro-Business... Constitutional Conservative.

** Born and raised in New Mexico... I’m a proud multi-generational native New Mexican.

My wife Doris and I have raised our family here – **We love New Mexico!**
* I am a member of the Pojoaque Knights of Columbus Council, Los Hermanos de Guadalupe.

* I have been elected twice to the Santa Fe County Commission.

* I was also elected and served on the Pojoaque School Board for 8 years.

* I have dedicated my life to serving God, my family, and my community.

* I have fought for Traditional New Mexican Values that are important to all of us AND I will continue to do so as your next State Treasurer.

* For too long, too many of us have stood by as New Mexico’s Progressive Political Machine has grown more and more repressive, heavy handed and un-American. It’s time to elect officials who work for the people, not the other way around. I will protect our tax-payer dollars and serve the people of our great state with the highest level of integrity, values, morals, openness, and transparency that we deserve.

**When we defeat Michelle Lujan Grisham and elect a Republican Governor in November, it’s important to have a State Treasurer who will work TOGETHER with our leadership to turn our state around!** My father passed away several years ago but before his passing, I had the opportunity to have the kinds of deep serious conversations sons and fathers too often put off having. His wisdom reinforced the value that doing no wrong is not the same as standing up for what’s right. **That is what this campaign is all about... having the****courage****to stand up for what’s right even when it’s the hard thing to do.****Are you ready to stand together with me?** Our campaign is about doing our part to change all of that. I’m running to give a voice to all of us – and it’s a growing number – who believe New Mexico deserves a State Treasurer that truly represents values of honesty, openness, and political freedom. Accountability and transparency are the pillars of a well-functioning Treasurer's office. I care deeply about our State, and Country and I would be honored to earn your vote to serve YOU as your next State Treasurer...You Matter!
So that we can build a better future for New Mexico, **will you consider investing in our campaign with your vote and a most generous contribution of $10, $25, $100 or any amount, today?** To invest in the future of our great Land of Enchantment, please click [HERE](http://links.markronchetti.com/u/click?_t=b07bd752cdb64edc94e23391776d0f53&_m=f5895e8ce1184156bbcf5efd79d508e1&_e=8_CXjbpQT5j_W_UtqFN4e2GKaN4oqnU1lMBpn5zr9V2iQndAXGzt9vWNRarxfrh3lAYNSpJqkxl8tYmLjGcHcJbmrKlt5ZX80on4XI7k35yRnXvZo2KXp0C1cSzYfR_AI-WSLK8MxJKQ6PUhR0dY_QBtWKLtzTPdDz1Lu4_RnKoC0YWSDi_FfzikkijWZhPsEK0d6RWBsO8ifXo-B1t5iCmtN-xe5j6Ur9_3wK4-45lx3BQ_7DmCY2m2G9AOEksgx4APH7eNIg_HfpUOKuCveQ%3D%3D) or send a check to the address below:

A Chuck Schumer-backed Super PAC, with the misleading name "VoteVets," released ANOTHER false attack ad going after me.

_**How low will they go before Election Day?**_

Peter, I want you to hear directly from me about these FALSE and misleading attacks:

| | Peter,

When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”

_I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House._

In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. **But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in.**

If we haven't met yet, [**I'm Nancy Mace**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=331904d3903846ad9f0a6a9330b0cfa6&_e=AvoSaEFMs6kHXi3Rv4bXHcW1HotQOmjsidYwehbJdfvhX8HC55vU5vp23cdh6KipsoFpL-Qfp3enzCyCaD8sWpFHQIaIpEQ_owa76Q8DIQnaeHYWnSClwDy44PEB1lbnlmvfA7zjAghY3xE6g2Ut_R7ZFNVFCa7_xOo9b5SaH3y35S45IEzkCcqiR90j3oPKzj3Hi1v37XWa0BZPKmfT84FwZ7Lf5MievYwMBEQGCEVrzahx12dbOKdkQcWa2LIZgvGUucve5uwB2Wf6Q-DKdTKLayRehGLk0B3EfArVUb7C_IkspsujyrmZbsDQ2b2XVS28HpAJGtR82zHnCu1SnD_T2gmI-l8XzvehUMpv1g8kXTQ2yl1bLokCAu0a7nPQ0sA6iL9URuQECIXwz5sxVOtO7nUoJX-zWRxH-sBQgiON_jcR9FYYw4DhsTpxaMD0dz3pvRjFFpSstrcQANzpmw%3D%3D). I'm a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America!

I don't have your typical run of the mill story because I'm not your typical Congresswoman. I ran for Congress because someone had to stand up and fight to protect the freedoms we have in our country and to serve the people of South Carolina.

In 2020, we took this seat back from the Democrats and now, we are fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red.

**I'm extremely proud of the work we've accomplished, but there's still so much to do. So, I want to make sure you are still on my team as[we continue on the path to re-election](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=331904d3903846ad9f0a6a9330b0cfa6&_e=AvoSaEFMs6kHXi3Rv4bXHcW1HotQOmjsidYwehbJdfvhX8HC55vU5vp23cdh6KipsoFpL-Qfp3enzCyCaD8sWpFHQIaIpEQ_owa76Q8DIQnaeHYWnSClwDy44PEB1lbnlmvfA7zjAghY3xE6g2Ut_R7ZFNVFCa7_xOo9b5SaH3y35S45IEzkCcqiR90j3oPKzj3Hi1v37XWa0BZPKmfT84FwZ7Lf5MievYwMBEQGCEVrzahx12dbOKdkQcWa2LIZoco5Cc9NrmGun2HAKNbKF-ruT18rhYcw-Ro18X-NHmz6UDt3AQaLKW4wcuSRAE4R7f9qz7UWtf-XoAgz4YmUI2TDAE5_VmQzvLm6MRqQLOt65RwHtZrQ8RIkO_gGRvXc7Otf70fJ-3IeaB80D1kB85X_-d77NKVM6P1vA4gYSWzZ5A_QyMqdk5lXFRt-jYNlFwf6v2hBXzaS0S7Du0zAug%3D%3D).**

[**Will you chip in whatever you can – whether it's $75, $50, or $10, so that I can win this race and restore our country.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=331904d3903846ad9f0a6a9330b0cfa6&_e=AvoSaEFMs6kHXi3Rv4bXHcW1HotQOmjsidYwehbJdfvhX8HC55vU5vp23cdh6KipsoFpL-Qfp3enzCyCaD8sWpFHQIaIpEQ_owa76Q8DIQnaeHYWnSClwDy44PEB1lbnlmvfA7zjAghY3xE6g2Ut_R7ZFNVFCa7_xOo9b5SaH3y35S45IEzkCcqiR90j3oPKzj3Hi1v37XWa0BZPKmfT84FwZ7Lf5MievYwMBEQGCEVrzahx12dbOKdkQcWa2LIZzrPBtVJxNEIV01fMH3mF5H7UW1Swr1eQld4EzWK2CenEC1IY_d4KrSGGPeqcQGj34emYb6VRAD1BPQzWwx2PqYDTPjGSkE3ta9VPgidUwCl_YqX6slJNHs24xgXpmwkpFEIDRAN4_B5rajKwx14Di-7TU0JOPrlkPAZTr1wG97kofmyJFtPHD1R1uEFevZahzLnjK01ZvGoawb30Gkj3jw%3D%3D)

[ ** Chip In ➞ **](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=331904d3903846ad9f0a6a9330b0cfa6&_e=AvoSaEFMs6kHXi3Rv4bXHcW1HotQOmjsidYwehbJdfvhX8HC55vU5vp23cdh6KipsoFpL-Qfp3enzCyCaD8sWpFHQIaIpEQ_owa76Q8DIQnaeHYWnSClwDy44PEB1lbnlmvfA7zjAghY3xE6g2Ut_R7ZFNVFCa7_xOo9b5SaH3y35S45IEzkCcqiR90j3oPKzj3Hi1v37XWa0BZPKmfT84FwZ7Lf5MievYwMBEQGCEVrzahx12dbOKdkQcWa2LIZEezTVuBgE5hQbUD46ZamQlOs4UZKcoCEptxDJMhpBrFbkn8quW-HU1WjQBUc0CPYxpAb4G8e90EKJIIHdruJ7CWTeOxXcXvcKuwsv2BjL_GNKPqwlZeCkJHc3pgk4td4dAWkDeftj3wwACI0ndhuWWEN8tO5vZWL9jBq1S31Jqp3dsoCw2b5tukjT_fj4nWD3D-4vLvKfFNMv-nXbTW-8g%3D%3D)

There was a time in my life when I never thought I'd get a high school diploma, _let alone graduate from The Citadel, one day start a company, and now serve in Congress._

I made a promise to myself when I won two years ago that I would be fiscally conservative; I would be an independent voice and I wouldn't toe the party line especially when Republicans spent too much and taxed too much.

| | “With women’s basic rights and bodily autonomy under severe attack in the U.S., Montana NOW is proud that the National Organization for Women's Political Action Committee (NOW PAC) has enthusiastically ratified our State Chapter’s recommendation to endorse Penny Ronning for U.S. Congresswoman for Montana’s 2nd Congressional District.

Penny Ronning is a strong Women’s and Human Rights Champion—not only rhetorically, but through years-long activism—who has consistently stood for equity for all. Ronning has made it her mission to stand for those who are at risk: Sexually trafficked girls and women, Missing and Murdered Indigenous People, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, small business people, and Montana’s family farmers and ranchers. She has a record of working successfully across the political aisle, and she listens to the voices of her constituents,” **said Marilynn Miller, Treasurer of Montana Chapter of NOW.**

### _Event at Buckhead City Headquarters is Wednesday!_
---
|
---
| Please join my campaign for an exciting event at the **Buckhead City Headquarters on Wednesday, July 20 from 6pm - 8pm** so that we can rally behind our right to vote on Buckhead cityhood!

Christian Zimm will be joined by **John Bailey** , House District 54 Candidate, and **Wendy Ahrenkiel** , House District 52 Candidate. There will be other special guests and candidates present. There will be a reception followed by speaking from Christian Zimm and other guests.

We will be discussing the recent crime, the new "mini" precinct", lagging 911 response times, and our pathway to city hood.

This event is a great opportunity to pick up some Buckhead City swag, a yard sign, and more.

Location: Buckhead City Headquarters; 3002 PEACHTREE RD NW, Atlanta, GA 30305

Time: 6pm - 8pm

Parking: You can park at the Buckhead City HQ or around the corner at the Truist Bank.

There will be some food and beverages available. Press is allowed to attend.

The suggested contribution at this event is $100, but any donation amount is welcome. Please RSVP to Patti Peach at 404-234-5884 and donate at [www.christianzimm.com/donate](https://christianzimm.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7004a54657965ddf2c517009f&id=5e3402803d&e=5ecfda27b2). You can also use Venmo @ZimmforCongress (last four digits are 7150 if asked).

Christian Zimm is the Republican Nominee for the 5th Congressional District and is endorsed by the Buckhead City Committee. He also serves as the Vice President of Communications for the Buckhead City Committee and believes that Buckhead residents should have the right to vote on cityhood.

See you there and thank you for your support!

Peter - they are coming after me again.

A Chuck Schumer-backed Super PAC, with the misleading name "VoteVets," released ANOTHER false attack ad going after me.

_**How low will they go before Election Day?**_

Peter, I want you to hear directly from me about these FALSE and misleading attacks:

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=95e207b3f7ea424ab9db3d9c0576ebe3&_e=L_rWCvlHrQM357mLjYiSMed9ZzUoEi-zSlclygrzjawWBRVUZbERTIvdSOYLOptuzlesJ6MqW2_ZGB_qdeGLXKqV1rJ9lAXbZDtqnbA89m44Xq6_djaEvYDDJWbUFF0JfWB5oPQ4QzuMaJpcRuqG357tLfyX_uxWCvyFnK8iVpHdv0QOt0L-f_k8geHLOno4CF-ZMDeNrK99vC4R9Dl4JOI3X6xdRALH4C5Y-7_mpv2JPCpGnbc5FrRqeFEjbVyTfWDrPx7UHryBSk7zgX-PW0jFOIdpwqJJHgHK763F13P7Wcat6oEJiJxkkIIKU30TcZiEgIMyILsbsdDyHdH1WB8flWSSyyhUk3N1sa8XsydEpdD6crJCon3wMnYvGqVjy0rY3Xw6IxCennzDj5nmo0vatvTciTQZ9jTCphFTn96UQ72Fc0fDpHMsvc8hm8AQ8sEZdrXnQAHGqNX0sKCd60Rc5U8CPHFlngcN828_KOSIcUyi0_vZSgg3BB9aeO_P)
"VoteVets" has a long track record of releasing blatantly false ads against Republican candidates.

I have dedicated over a decade of my life to traveling the country meeting with members of our military to share my mental health journey, inspire hope for people who are struggling, and remove stigmas around seeking treatment.

Last week, Politico published an important article on the role "insider threats" play in threatening our election security. In short, it shows again the importance of having stable and competent leadership in charge of our elections.
Check out the article below and then contribute to Jocelyn's re-election campaign. It is crucial that she remains Michigan's chief elections officer.

Donate>> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=071822

Election officials fear copycat attacks as "insider threats" loom

by Zach Montellaro

Election officials are confronting a wave of threats and security challenges coming from a troubling source: inside the election system itself.

The threat to our nation’s democracy is the most critical and urgent issue of our time. While the inability to pass critical protections at the federal level is disheartening, as three veteran public servants with decades of experience in the states, we still see a path forward for free and fair elections.

In interviews on the sidelines of the National Association of Secretaries of State’s summer conference, a dozen chief election administrators detailed a growing number of “insider threats” leading to attempted or successful election security breaches aided by local officials. The most prominent was in Colorado, where a county clerk was indicted for her role in facilitating unauthorized access to voting machines. But there have been similar instances elsewhere, including in Pennsylvania, Michigan and Ohio.

Beyond security breaches, other insider efforts to undermine elections have sprouted. In New Mexico last month, the board of commissioners in Otero County — a predominantly Republican county along the state’s southern border with Texas — refused to certify primary election results, citing unfounded claims about the security of voting machines that are rooted in conspiracy theories about hacked election equipment from the 2020 election.

“What’s clear is this is a nationally coordinated effort,” said Michigan Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson, a Democrat. “It’s multi-year, multi-faceted ... not just pressuring election officials, but pressuring local elected officials as well.”

But the election in November is closing in. Winning won’t be easy, but luckily, I know how to win an election. That’s why I launched Stand For America PAC last year to train, endorse, advise, and financially support strong conservative candidates who I know will fight for Americans like us. I’m reaching out to recruit you for my Ambassador’s Circle membership, friend. Right now, my team is offering a 50% discount on membership dues so that anyone who has even $12 can be a member today. We’ve endorsed strong candidates and helped many conservative leaders win their primaries. But we need your help to fuel a red wave and take control of the House and the Senate. We can crush the liberal agenda, and I want you to join me. Your membership plays a key role. Republicans have momentum, but we still have our work cut out for us. It would be truly frightening to leave our Constitution and our freedoms in the hands of the radical Left. Stand For America PAC will continue to fight for people like you. You can help us continue to win and push the Democrats out of office. I am proud to work alongside you in defending our American values. Thank you again for supporting Stand For America PAC. My very best, Nikki Haley | | | A Note From Nikki: Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged.
